jobs.title: Immediate Care Technician-Immediate Care Center Huntley Part Time Days
jobs.description:
**This is a Full Time position at 24 hours per week for the Immediate Care Center located at the Huntley clinic.  This would be 2, 12hr shifts from 7:45am-8:15pm with weekend and holiday coverage requirement. Floating to other clinics may be required. Must be a CMA or EMT.**

The Immediate Care Technician reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Immediate Care Technician supports physicians (MD) and advance practice providers (APP) by facilitating patient flow, assisting with various patient care activities, and performing related administrative functions. This role is responsible for ensuring efficient patient flow; maintaining neat, clean and safe patient care areas;  promoting patient satisfaction by interacting with patients in a professional, friendly manner; safeguarding patient confidentiality.

Responsibilities:

Description

• Assures efficient patient flow through the site:

• Escorts patient to exam room, identifies patient with 2 identifiers and prepares patient for examination.
• Obtains accurate vital signs, per organization standards.
• Documents reason for visit and updates/confirms, allergies, smoking history and pharmacy information.
• Promptly informs the MD/APP of any significant change in vital signs or acute symptoms.
• Anticipates/sets up equipment or supplies needed for visit.
• Cleans and prepares exam room for next patient.
• Responds to needs to expedite visits and maintain flow of patients and prioritize tasks accordingly.
• Assists with referrals, transfers and discharge processes.

• Assists MD/APP with medical and surgical procedures in accordance with established protocols such as:

• Electrocardiogram (ECG), venipuncture, immunizations, setting up procedure trays, specimen. collection and/or Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) waived testing, wound care, splinting, as directed by MD/APP.
• Call-in or electronically send prescriptions as directed by the MD/APP.

• Provides high quality care by:

• Prepares and stocks all exam rooms in treatment area by following established protocols for disinfecting and sterilizing equipment and instruments.
• Participates in environmental safety rounds.
• Maintains vaccine/medication inventory.
• Ensures medication cabinets are locked appropriately.
• Monitors and maintains equipment and instruments according to clinic guidelines.
• Assists in ordering supplies and correctly disposes of all expired items.
• Adheres to office opening and closing procedures.

• Functions as an integral part of the patient care team and promotes patient satisfaction by interacting with patients in a professional, friendly manner:Interacts in a professional, cooperative manner with other practice staff.Accepts and performs delegated responsibilities in a positive manner.Offers assistance to others.Attends and participates in staff meetings.Communicates appropriately and effectively with patients and patient care team (in the office and on the phone).
• Performs delegated procedures common to the specialty area in a safe, effective, and efficient manner (see specialty practice addendum).
• May perform other duties as assigned.

Required:

• High school diploma or GED equivalent.
• Candidate must have written proof of meeting candidate eligibility requirements for writing one of the five eligible certification exams (AAMA, AMT, NCCT, NHA, NRCMA)Accepted documentation:New MA Graduates within 6 months from date of graduation from an MA Program must submit: a letter from the school or a letter from the certifying bodyNon-Certified MAs or new graduates past 6 months from date of graduation from an MA program must submit: a letter from the certifying body
• Within first six months of employment, will complete one of the following certifications after up to two test attempts:Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) through American Association of Medical Assistants (AAMA)Registered Medical Assistant (RMA) through American Medical Technologists (AMT) orNational Certified Medical Assistant (NCMA) through the National Center for Competency Testing (NCCT)Certified Clinical Medical Assistant (CCMA) through the National Healthcareer Association (NHA)Nationally Registered Certified Medical Assistant (NRCMA) through the National Association for Health Professionals (NAHP

OR

• Emergency Medical Technician – Paramedic, or Emergency Medical Technician – Basic (National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians) certification OR Illinois EMT LicenseCertification required upon hire.
• Basic Life Support (American Heart Association) certification.
• Completion of pre-employment competency exam.
• Strong computer skills.

Preferred:

• Experience with electronic medical record.
• College degree or interest in health care field preferred.
• One to two years of ambulatory care experience.

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

jobs.title: Senior Vice President, Development
jobs.description:
ABOUT PER SCHOLAS:

For 30 years, Per Scholas has been on a mission to drive mobility and opportunity in the ever-advancing technology landscape by unlocking the untapped potential of individuals, uplifting communities, and meeting the needs of employers through rigorous tech training. By teaming up with dynamic employer partners, ranging from Fortune 500 companies to innovative startups, we're forging inclusive tech talent pipelines, fulfilling an ever-increasing need for skilled talent. With national remote training and campuses in 20+ cities and counting, Per Scholas offers no-cost training programs in the most sought-after tech skills, spanning Cloud, Cybersecurity, Data Engineering, IT Support, Software Engineering, and more. To date, 30,000+ individuals have been trained through Per Scholas, propelling their professional trajectories into high-growth tech careers with salaries three times higher than their pre-training earnings. Learn more by visiting PerScholas.org and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube.

Per Scholas candidates must reside in one of the following states, provided the position does not carry a specific office location requirement: AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, MD, MA, MI, MO, NC, NJ, NY, OH, PA, TX, WA, WI.

Senior Vice President, Development, Corporate Partnerships

Position Title:

Senior Vice President, Development, Corporate Partnerships

Department:

Fundraising / Development Leadership

Reports To:

Chief Development Officer

Office / Location:

Hybrid (Preference for candidates located in the New York City Metro area)

Job Summary — Who We Are Looking For

We are seeking a strategic, relationship-driven Senior Vice President, Development, Corporate Partnerships to lead the growth, retention, and acquisition of national corporate revenue. Bringing over a decade of senior executive fundraising experience, strong analytical storytelling skills, and people-centered leadership, you will manage a high-impact portfolio of Fortune 500 and major foundation partners while coaching our national corporate development team. Your leadership will directly fuel Per Scholas’s mission to advance economic equity and mobility by securing the sustainable resources needed to prepare learners nationwide for thriving, high-growth tech careers.

What You'll Do

• Manage Strategic National Portfolios: Directly cultivate, manage, and steward a portfolio of Per Scholas’s largest Fortune 500 corporate funders and major foundations to ensure deep engagement and mission alignment.

• Lead Channel Strategy & Growth: Architect and execute a comprehensive fundraising roadmap to expand and diversify multi-year national corporate revenue, inclusive of pro bono support and corporate volunteerism.

• Represent Per Scholas Externally: Serve as a compelling storyteller and executive ambassador at national conferences, external events, and high-stakes donor meetings.

• Coach & Mentor Development Talent: Lead, mentor, and manage national corporate development personnel, fostering a collaborative culture and best practices in high-level fundraising.

• Advise C-Suite & Executive Leadership: Act as the organization's subject matter expert on corporate philanthropy, providing strategic guidance to C-suite executives and national leaders engaging with high-level donors.

• Drive Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with the VP of Market-Based Fundraising, Talent Solutions, Employer Partnerships, Program, and Marketing teams to align national goals with local campus needs and ensure unified donor messaging.

• Translate Data into Compelling Proposals: Oversee the creation of high-impact concepts, grant proposals, and boardroom-ready presentations that turn complex workforce outcomes into persuasive cases for support.

• Advance Industry Thought Leadership: Monitor emerging trends in the tech sector, labor market, and philanthropy to position Per Scholas as a premier workforce development partner.

• Maintain Operational & Data Excellence: Uphold technical standards, pipeline integrity, and compliance with donor intent across the national corporate development channel.

What You'll Bring To Us

• Executive Fundraising Track Record: 10+ years of senior leadership experience in corporate development, foundation relations, strategic partnerships, or nonprofit executive fundraising, with a proven history of securing six- and seven-figure institutional gifts.

• Strategic & Inventive Mindset: Ability to design long-term revenue growth strategies, build authentic funder relationships, and thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

• Inspiring People Leadership: Demonstrated success coaching, mentoring, and managing high-performing fundraising teams toward ambitious multi-million-dollar revenue targets.

• Executive Presence & Communication Mastery: Exceptional written and verbal storytelling skills, with the confidence to advise C-suite executives and present persuasively to corporate boards.

• Analytical & Financial Acumen: Strong ability to synthesize complex programmatic data into clear impact narratives and oversee multi-faceted funding agreements.

• Technical & Collaboration Proficiency: Advanced experience using Salesforce for pipeline management and revenue forecasting, alongside mastery of Google Workspace and Slack.

• Flexibility to Travel: Willingness and ability to travel ad hoc for donor site visits, national team retreats, and major fundraising events.

• Commitment to Economic Equity: A deep passion for social change, bridging the tech opportunity gap, and advancing Per Scholas’s mission.

Per Scholas offers a competitive salary $175,000 - $190,000 depending on experience, location and a comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and vision coverage, a retirement match, generous paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

Benefits & Perks

Per Scholas offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and overall quality of life!

Holidays & PTO: Full-Time Per Scholas team members enjoy over 40 days of paid time off each year through a mix of holidays, vacation, and sick/personal time! All employees are eligible for Holiday pay upon hire (a total of 22 holidays annually, including a week off for Independence day and a week before the New Year). Full-Time Benefits Eligible employees also receive 80 Wellness Hours to use for Sick, Safe, or Personal reasons and accrue Vacation at a rate of 8 hours at the beginning of every month, supporting rest, recharge, and work-life balance. Vacation accruals increase with tenure. Part-time employees are afforded time off on a prorated basis and in accordance with local requirements.

Comprehensive Medical Coverage: Benefit eligible employees can choose from multiple medical plans through Cigna or Kaiser Permanente (where available), with options to fit your needs. Eligible employees also have access to a Health Reimbursement Account (HRA) that reimburses eligible out-of-pocket expenses, up to $4,000 for individuals and $8,000 for families.

Dental and Vision Insurance: Eligible employees can select from two dental plan options and a vision plan. Employees who waive medical coverage receive employer paid dental and vision premiums.

Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with a current 100% employer match on contributions up to 6%, eligible employees are offered entry and full vesting after 90 days with the company.

Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Free, confidential, 24/7 access to counseling, legal support, and financial resources for employees and their household members

Parental Leave: Eligible employees are offered up to 6 weeks of 100% paid parental leave to support employees as they welcome a new child and bond with their family.

Additional Benefits & Perks: Eligible employees have access to employer-paid life and AD&D Insurance, as well as employer-paid short-term disability coverage, with the option to elect additional life coverage and long-term disability insurance. Flexible Spending accounts are available for healthcare, dependent care, and commuting expenses. Per Scholas also offers a range of voluntary benefits, including: Accident, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Legal Services, and Pet Insurance. Additional resources include healthcare concierge support, financial wellness tools, and employee discount programs.

QUESTIONS?

If you have any questions about this role, please feel free to email our Talent team at jobs@perscholas.org. We look forward to viewing your application!

Equal Employment Opportunity

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin.

PII Policies

Non-Discrimination Policy

jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
jobs.description:
🏢 ABOUT GRANTED

Granted is building an AI-native healthcare expert for families, starting with lowering medical bills and navigating insurance. Our AI agents proactively monitor bills, find savings and get bills lowered, with healthcare experts overseeing complex cases. Members only pay when they save.

Under the hood is our agentic operating system for healthcare navigation and advocacy. One of our moats is our proprietary Plaid-like technology, which lets members link to virtually every healthcare provider and insurer in the U.S. and brings a fragmented system together in one platform.

We've served 30,000 families, with savings and revenue growing 2 to 3x every quarter over the past year. We recently launched a benefits broker partnership covering 1.2M lives, with more major benefits platforms in conversation. Our founder and CEO, Julien Nakache, spent eight years as an engineering leader at Oscar Health, from pre-revenue through IPO.

We're 30 people, based in New York, with $30M+ raised from Forerunner, SemperVirens, RRE, plus the founders from Hugging Face, Rocket Money, Oscar and many others.




🧭 ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll be Granted's first COO, reporting to Julien (Founder & CEO). You'll own everything that makes the business run outside of product, engineering and marketing: turning strategy into execution, building the systems and teams that let us scale, and making the operating calls that keep the company moving fast.

In your first year, you'll build and operate the system for Granted's next stage of growth: from strategy and planning to aggressive execution against our ambitious roadmap. You'll be the person the company turns to when something needs to get done right.




🛠 WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Strategy and operations: lead the company's biggest bets from idea to launch, whether that's entering a new market, rethinking pricing or building a new partner model. You'll scope the opportunity, make the business case and see it through.

 - Business operations: enhance the company operating system to one that unlocks further business growth. Set company goals, run the cadence that keeps every team accountable to them, and turn data into decisions for the leadership team.

 - Finance and planning: budget, forecasting, cash and runway, board and investor reporting. Manage our fractional CFO and accounting partners.

 - Partnerships and BD: shape partnership strategy and make the key calls on which partners, deals and terms best serve the business and patients, long term.

 - People: shape how Granted grows as an organization. Design the org, set the leveling and comp philosophy, and build a performance culture that keeps the bar high as we scale, in partnership with our Talent and People lead.

 - Legal and contracting: own the agreements that power the business, from major partner deals to vendor and customer contracts. Work with outside counsel to move fast while protecting the company.




🧰 YOU'LL BRING


MUST-HAVES

 - A top MBA, or ~3+ years at a top consulting firm or bank, followed by real operating roles.

 - Startup or high-growth experience, where you built functions from scratch, not just ran mature ones.

 - Commercial and financial rigor: you've owned a P&L, a budget or a revenue number, and you can build the model yourself.

 - You've built and led high-performing teams across multiple functions, and hired great people into them.

 - A structured thinker and clear, direct communicator who challenges the CEO and leadership team with conviction.

 - Fluency in how US business and healthcare work: payers, employers, brokers, benefits.

 - AI-native in how you work.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - GM or multi-function leadership at a consumer health, insurtech or benefits company.

 - Experience with partnerships or B2B2C distribution.




✨ YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You move with urgency and focus. You can look at ten competing priorities, pick the two that matter most, and cut the rest without hesitation.

 - You own the outcome, not just the process. When something you're accountable for slips, you're the first to call it out and the first to fix it.

 - You treat feedback as fuel. You give direct, candid feedback at every level, CEO included, and actively seek it on your own work.

 - You play to win. You want to help build a category-defining company, and you care that winning means more families stop getting crushed by medical bills.




📍 WHERE YOU'LL WORK

Office based by Union Square, NYC. In-office Monday through Thursday, with Fridays remote.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Summary

GrayMatter Robotics is a well-capitalized Physical AI company headquartered in Los Angeles, building Factory SuperIntelligence (FSI) through systems that learn, adapt, and develop genuine process intelligence across every part they touch. Our robots take on the tedious, hazardous, and ergonomically demanding work that has kept manufacturing dependent on a shrinking skilled workforce, delivering superhuman performance. Robotics has a demo problem. GMR doesn't. Our systems are in active production today, adapting autonomously to real geometries, real materials, and real process variation without reprogramming. We deliver our system through a Robots-as-a-Service (RaaS) model that converts capital expenditure into an operating subscription, making Physical AI accessible to the manufacturers who need it most. We hire people who want to solve hard physical problems at an industrial scale.



Role at a Glance

Forward Deployed Engineers at GMR build our business inside one customer at a time. You go to the customer's floor, take an ambiguous problem and define it clearly, then design, build and prove a solution that moves the customer's numbers. You own the result from the first conversation through operator adoption, and you carry what you learn back into the platform so the next customer benefits. Time to value matters, so you ship a working first version quickly and improve it with the people who use it.



What You Will Do

 - Get to the root of the problem. You'll work directly with customers, operators, and engineers to understand what's actually happening on the factory floor, challenge initial assumptions, and define the problems worth solving.

 - Take solutions across the finish line. You'll connect the dots across software, hardware, and manufacturing, make practical decisions, and drive execution until your work translates into meaningful results for the customer.

 - Turn local solutions into broader capabilities. You'll build features tailored to individual customer environments using GMR's platform infrastructure, while identifying opportunities to contribute those solutions back to the generalized platform.

 - Expand your reach through collaboration. You'll know when to bring in subject matter experts, leverage internal teams, and look beyond engineering to find the right solution. Success means understanding the bigger picture, from supply chain considerations to customer relationships.

 - Stay curious and keep building. No two problems are exactly alike. You'll continuously develop new skills, adapt to evolving technologies, and leverage AI tools to work smarter and push your engineering capabilities further.

 - Travel to customer sites approximately 50% of the time.



About You

You are autonomous and high-agency, and you do whatever it takes to get the job done. You identify and define problems well in ambiguous situations, solve them effectively and efficiently, and stay relentless on the customer floor. You understand that a working first version delivered fast is worth more than a polished one delivered late.

You think from first principles and teach yourself new engineering skills without hand-holding. You use AI tools and seek subject matter experts to extend your engineering. You think in software, hardware, and process, and you weigh speed against engineering quality with good judgment. You know what an MVP looks like at a customer site. You communicate clearly with operators, executives, and engineers, and you can break work into near-term engineering steps while holding a longer-term strategy.

No specific degree or years of experience are required. Show us what you have built, fixed, or taught yourself, especially in messy real-world conditions.



Export Control Requirements

In order to comply with the export regulations of the United States Government, it is required that the applicant must fall under one of the following categories: (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (i.e. current green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158.



Minimum Qualifications

We recognize that strong technical foundations can be developed through many different paths. Whether you're early in your career, bring years of hands-on experience, or have built your expertise through self-directed learning and independent exploration, we're interested in how you've developed your knowledge, strengthened your skills, and demonstrated your ability to apply these fundamentals.

 - Core engineering fundamentals: coordinate frames and transforms, forward and inverse kinematics, and how a sensor is positioned and calibrated within a robot's working environment.

 - Hands-on comfort with an off-the-shelf robot controller: setting one up, running it, and debugging it when it misbehaves.

 - Electrical and mechatronics competence in a hands-on setting: reading and debugging circuits, working with PLCs and microcontrollers, and understanding machine safety practice around industrial equipment.

 - Excellent prompt engineering - sufficient to prototype an idea, analyze data and build a feature.

 - The ability to take an ambiguous problem and break it into a system architecture and a plan, including choosing between candidate approaches on technical merit.

 - Clear communication with operators, engineers and executives, often on the same day and about the same problem.

 - Willingness to travel to customer sites approximately 50 percent of the time.

 - Must meet export control requirements in the United States and maintain ongoing work authorization beginning at the time of hire through the entirety of employment.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Hands-on work with robot arms, including integrating a motion interface such as ROS-Industrial, MoveIt or a vendor motion API.

 - Practical experience with vision sensors that you set up, calibrated and tuned yourself, on anything from an inexpensive off-the-shelf camera to a production vision system.

 - Experience with a robotics middleware or networking framework such as ROS, together with the network layer underneath it: moving data between robot controllers, sensors and higher-level software, working with industrial communication protocols, and bringing a distributed set of devices up and talking to each other on one network.

 - Work in a physics or robotics simulator, for example Isaac or Omniverse, Gazebo, RViz or MATLAB.

 - Familiarity with path planning and motion planning algorithms and the tradeoffs between them.

 - Demonstrated judgment in selecting the right algorithmic approach for a cyber-physical system or Physical AI implementation

 - Building your own data collection tooling while prototyping, and experience assembling datasets or training models for physical systems.

 - Use of AI-assisted engineering tools to move faster on design, analysis or implementation.

 - Working knowledge of manufacturing processes and how process parameters change the outcome on a real part. Experience in surface finishing manufacturing processes such as sanding, grinding, blasting or coating. Engineering mechanics and materials fundamentals, including how force, contact and abrasive media physically change a surface.

 - Measurement and documentation discipline: using standard metrology tools, and recording process data rigorously, including the visual and physical evidence that does not come out of a log file.

 - CAD and 3D modeling, including producing and reading manufacturing drawings.

 - Customer-facing deployment or commissioning experience in a live production environment.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage and embrace applicants of all backgrounds to apply!

jobs.title: Hardware Prototyping Technician
jobs.description:
ABOUT OBVIO AI

Each year, more than 40,000 people in the U.S. leave home and never make it back due to traffic crashes. At Obvio, we believe these deaths are preventable. We deploy solar-powered, AI-assisted cameras to enforce traffic laws where pedestrians are most vulnerable, automating enforcement in ways that traditional systems cannot. Our approach has already led to a 50% reduction in reckless driving in early partner cities.


Founded by the team behind Motive's AI dashcam and backed by Bain Capital Ventures and Khosla Ventures, we are building the intelligence layer for safer streets globally.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a hands-on Hardware Prototyping Technician to join our dynamic hardware team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for in-house prototyping, product assembly, logistics, and process optimization to support the development and deployment of our cutting-edge AI-powered solutions. You will collaborate closely with the engineering team to ensure prototypes are built to design specifications, production workflows are streamlined, and inventory is tracked with precision.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Rapid Hardware Prototyping: Build and iterate cutting-edge hardware prototypes alongside engineers, turning early concepts into functional systems within days—not months.

 - Hands-on System Integration: Assemble complex electro-mechanical systems including PCBs, sensors, compute modules, and mechanical assemblies to bring prototypes to life.

 - Fast Iteration Lab Environment: Operate in a high-velocity prototyping lab—debugging, modifying, and rebuilding hardware quickly to support aggressive engineering timelines.

 - Prototype Infrastructure & Lab Operations: Maintain the tools, components, and lab environment that enable rapid experimentation and continuous hardware iteration.

 - Component & Prototype Logistics: Ensure critical components and prototype builds move seamlessly through the lab so engineers can test and validate designs without delay.

 - Engineer-in-the-Loop Collaboration: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with electrical, mechanical, and firmware teams to unblock prototype builds, improve manufacturability, and accelerate product development.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong background in hands-on prototyping, assembly, or manufacturing processes.

 - Familiarity with hardware tools, fabrication methods, and test equipment.

 - Experience with logistics, inventory management systems, and process tracking.

 - Ability to read and understand technical drawings, schematics, and BOMs.

 - Excellent problem-solving, organization, and time management skills.

 - Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - Associate degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering Technology, Mechanical Engineering Technology, or a related technical field (or equivalent hands-on experience).

 - 3+ years of hands-on experience building and assembling hardware prototypes in a lab or production environment.

 - Strong practical skills with soldering, wiring, PCB bring-up, and general electronics assembly.

 - Experience working with engineering teams to rapidly build and iterate hardware prototypes.

 - Ability to work independently in a fast-moving environment and manage multiple prototype builds simultaneously.

 - Experience working in startup or early-stage product development environments is highly preferred.


PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

 - Hands-on experience with camera systems, sensors, or embedded/AI hardware platforms.

 - Experience debugging prototype hardware and supporting early hardware validation.

 - Comfort working with oscilloscopes, power supplies, multimeters, and other lab equipment.

 - Experience with rapid prototyping tools (3D printing, CNC, laser cutting, etc.).

 - Knowledge of lean manufacturing practices or Six Sigma.

 - Exposure to hardware startups or R&D environments.




WHY OBVIO

 - Your work will help save lives and improve road safety

 - Series A of $54M

 - Fast-moving startup environment with meaningful ownership

 - Competitive compensation and early-stage equity

jobs.title: Consultant, GIS and Digitalization
jobs.description:
Hybrid-based position in our Seattle, WA office.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. No sponsorship is available for this position.

Are you excited about understanding, interpreting, and navigating complex issues? Are you motivated by creating sustainable change that benefits society and nature? Are you a curious and open-minded person?

If this sounds like you, or you are curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Environment & Health team as our new Consultant and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.

Your new role

Ramboll is seeking a GIS Consultant based in Seattle, Washington to work as part of a collaborative team providing GIS, data management, and analytical support for environmental and consulting projects. You will work with project managers, scientists, engineers, field teams, and other technical staff to develop maps, manage, and analyze project data, support digital applications, and prepare client-specific deliverables.

The successful candidate will be able to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment and serving as a technical GIS resource for project managers and staff. Common needs include geospatial data management, spatial analysis, mapping and visualization, presentation development, quality control, and development and maintenance of web-based GIS applications and workflows. This role also includes opportunities to communicate findings and technical information directly to clients and project teams.

This is primarily an office-based position. The role will support field activities through the configuration and maintenance of digital data collection tools, preparation of GIS data and applications for field teams, troubleshooting, and management and validation of field-collected data.

Your key tasks and responsibilities will be:

• Develop maps, spatial analyses, data visualizations, and other client-ready deliverables supporting environmental and consulting projects.
• Manage, integrate, and perform QA/QC on geospatial and project data from multiple sources.
• Develop and maintain ArcGIS Online web maps, applications, dashboards, and other GIS-based workflows.
• Configure and support digital field-data collection tools, including preparing applications for field teams and validating field-collected data.
• Collaborate with project managers, scientists, engineers, field teams, and clients to translate project needs into practical GIS and data-management solutions.

About you

• Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Geography, Geology, Geomatics, Environmental Science, Engineering, or a related field and 3+ years of relevant professional experience; or a master’s degree in one of these fields and relevant experience.
• Experience using Esri desktop and web-based GIS products, including ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Online.
• Demonstrated skills in spatial analysis, geospatial database management, mapping, data visualization, and data QA/QC.
• Ability to work independently, manage multiple assignments, and contribute effectively within multidisciplinary and multi-user project teams.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical information clearly to project teams and clients.

What we can offer you

• Meaningful, high-impact work
• Flexible and hybrid work arrangements
• Competitive compensation and benefits
• Professional development and leadership opportunities
• A collaborative and inclusive culture
• The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $76,318 - $95,397 per year. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll in the Americas

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment & Health, Water, Energy, and Planning & Urban Design.

Where People Flourish

Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do.  Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, regardless of age, disability or medical condition, gender identity, marriage and domestic partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, ancestry, or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, military service and veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Ramboll wants to ensure opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. So, please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com with such requests.

Ready to join us?

Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.

As part of our hiring process, Ramboll may conduct pre-employment drug screenings for applicable roles to ensure a safe and compliant workplace.  You may be subject to random drug testing in accordance with client requirements.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Training
jobs.description:
Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week



Please note that eligibility may vary depending on your location, as some regions may not be supported by the client.

Check out this Loom video for more details: https://www.loom.com/share/b0d1b0bf24c44ae8b95dca84b9db60e5



We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.



This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.




WHAT THIS ROLE ACTUALLY IS

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:

• Whether the response makes sense

• Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful

• Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment

• Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

• Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end

• Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think

• Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code

• Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)

• Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading

• Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code




WHAT WE MEAN BY "TASTE"

We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

• Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?

• Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?

• Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?

• Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.




WHO YOU ARE

• Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)

• Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python

• Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor

• Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows

• Able to evaluate code without executing it or reviewing every line

• Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above). You'll be writing detailed feedback and recording short video explanations, so this is a hard requirement

• Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback

• High bar for what good engineering looks like




NICE TO HAVE

• Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows

• Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards




ENGAGEMENT DETAILS

• Rate: $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location

• Hours: 10-20 hours/week, flexible

• Duration: ongoing. Projects run from about two weeks to a few months each, and we offer new ones to evaluators who do well

• Start: as soon as you clear the take-home and a project has an open seat

• Process: one take-home evaluation exercise with a recorded Loom walkthrough. No interview

jobs.title: Senior Car Insurance Pricing Expert (Relocation to TLV)
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Senior Car Insurance Pricing Expert to help shape how Lemonade prices risk across our global business, from our Tel Aviv office.

This isn't a traditional actuarial role. You'll sit at the intersection of Insurance, Data Science, Product, Engineering, and Business Strategy on our Insurance team, owning hard pricing and risk-management problems end to end. That means finding opportunities, designing better approaches, building scalable tools with technical teams, and turning insights into decisions that move growth, profitability, and risk selection forward.

You might be a trained actuary, a pricing leader, a decision scientist, or a technically strong insurance operator who's built serious pricing capabilities. Formal credentials are a plus, but they're not the point. The point is whether you can use data, insurance intuition, statistical rigor, and AI-enabled tools to solve complex pricing problems better and faster than the industry standard.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.



IN THIS ROLE YOU'LL

 - Own and evolve core components of Lemonade's Car pricing strategy, bringing analytical rigor and product-minded creativity to how we price risk

 - Identify high-leverage opportunities across rating, underwriting, segmentation, risk selection, growth, profitability, and portfolio management

 - Build, evaluate, and improve Car pricing and risk models using actuarial methods, machine learning, AI-enabled workflows, and strong business judgment

 - Partner with Data Science, Product, Engineering, Finance, and Growth to turn pricing ideas into scalable capabilities

 - Translate complex pricing problems into clear product and platform requirements, helping teams build internal tools that make better decisions faster

 - Define and track key metrics - loss ratio, rate adequacy, conversion, retention, segmentation lift, and model performance - to keep decisions grounded in real impact

 - Make complex actuarial and pricing concepts clear and actionable for technical and non-technical audiences alike, and help build pricing acumen across the Tel Aviv team


WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - 8+ years of experience in Car insurance pricing, actuarial science, decision science, risk analytics, or a closely related field

 - A proven track record solving complex pricing, underwriting, segmentation, or risk-management problems with measurable business impact

 - Strong analytical instincts - knowing how to find signal in data, make decisions under uncertainty, and separate elegant analysis from useful analysis

 - Hands-on fluency with modern analytical tools, agentic AI capabilities, and code - including experience using generative AI, coding agents, or advanced automation to materially improve analytical workflows

 - Solid understanding of Car insurance pricing fundamentals, including rating plans, loss costs, rate adequacy, segmentation, model validation, telematics and financial performance.

 - Familiarity with predictive modeling methods such as GLMs, gradient boosting, random forests, clustering, and feature engineering

 - Experience building or modernizing pricing platforms, rating engines, underwriting tools, or internal decision-support software

 - Product-minded problem solving: the ability to turn a messy workflow, technical constraint, or business problem into a clear, prioritized path forward - with a track record of partnering with Product and Engineering teams to ship production-grade tools

 - Strong communication skills - you can explain pricing decisions, tradeoffs, and model outputs clearly to executives, engineers, product teams, and regulators

 - Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where ownership matters, ambiguity is normal, and AI is part of how work gets done

 - Experience leading pricing work across multiple geographies, products, or regulatory environments is a strong plus

 - Formal actuarial credentials, such as Fellow or Associate of a recognized actuarial society, are a plus

 - Bachelor's degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field

 - Ready to work in an office environment most days of the week

jobs.title: Supplier Quality Engineer I
jobs.description:
General Summary
As a Supplier Quality Engineer I at Penumbra, you will play a key role in ensuring our supply chain consistently delivers components and materials that meet the highest standards of quality and compliance. Working closely with cross-functional partners in Operations, Compliance, and R&D, you will support supplier qualifications, changes, corrective actions, and performance monitoring. You’ll help resolve supplier-related issues, drive improvements, and ensure adherence to Penumbra’s Quality Management System (QMS) and regulatory requirements. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career engineer to build a strong foundation in supplier quality, gain exposure to medical device manufacturing, and grow within a high-impact quality organization. You’ll join a collaborative and growing Quality organization that invests in technical development and career growth.
 
Specific Duties and Responsibilities 
• Support day-to-day supplier quality issues and coordinate with Engineering and Operations to communicate and collaborate with suppliers.
• Provide technical and quality support for Incoming Quality Control (IQC) and contribute to improvement initiatives for supplier and IQC processes.
• Participate in the alignment of supplier inspection and testing methods with Penumbra’s internal methodologies.
• Investigate supplier-related failures (e.g., IQC nonconformances) and support corrective and preventive actions.
• Assist in Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCARs), Second Source Qualifications (SSQs), and Supplier Change (SC) activities, including risk assessments and documentation.
• Initiate and manage Supplier Notifications (SNs) and track supplier quality actions to closure.
• Support the monitoring and trending of supplier performance metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
• Assist with qualification and ongoing management of suppliers on the Approved Supplier List (ASL).
• Ensure adherence to Penumbra’s QMS and applicable domestic and international regulations (e.g., QSR, ISO 13485).
• Collaborate cross-functionally to strengthen supplier partnerships and drive continuous improvement in product quality and reliability.
 
Position Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, or a related field.
• 1+ years of experience in Quality, Manufacturing, or Engineering; prior exposure to a regulated industry (medical device, pharmaceutical, aerospace, etc.) preferred.
• Foundational knowledge of quality systems (QSR, ISO 13485) and risk-based quality principles.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an interest in statistical methods.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across teams and suppliers.
• Proficiency with standard business tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and statistical software).
 
Location and Pay
• Alameda, CA
• Starting Base Salary: $76,000/year to $100,000/year
We offer a competitive compensation package plus a benefits and equity program, when applicable.
Individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location.
 
What You Bring
• A passion for detailed analysis and problem solving.
• A desire for growing project management skills and a drive to plan and execute projects that align with business needs.
• The desire to be part of a great team and to support Supplier Quality Engineering on cross-functional technical teams.
• The ability to lead with humility, a collaborative mindset, and confidence.
• Strong oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
• The ability to present issues, plans, and objectives in a clear, both orally and in writing.
• Versatility, flexibility, and a willingness to work within changing priorities.
 
Working Conditions
• General office, laboratory, and cleanroom environments
• Willingness and ability to work on site. 
• Business travel from 10% - 20%
• Potential exposure to blood-borne pathogens
• Requires some lifting and moving of up to 25 pounds
• Must be able to move between buildings and floors. 
• Must be able to remain stationary and use a computer or other standard office equipment, such as a printer or copy machine, for an extensive period of time each day. 
• Must be able to read, prepare emails, and produce documents and spreadsheets.   
• Must be able to move within the office and access file cabinets or supplies, as needed.

jobs.description:
PayPayについて/About PayPay

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7600万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

AIを含む最新技術とデータを駆使し、圧倒的なスピードでサービス開発と事業成長を実現します。 日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、ユーザーの為に新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

業務について

▼CS本部 CSシステム企画部のご紹介
プロダクト・Techとビジネスの橋渡し役となることをミッションにした少数精鋭で編成されたチームです。プロダクト部門とビジネス部門の間で付加価値のあるハブになることで、社内の円滑なコミュニケーション、迅速な障害解消をサポートする部門です。
社内関係先はCS・ビジネス・営業・リスク部門等と幅広く、また業務範囲も障害といったネガティブな案件から、プロジェクト推進まで、プロダクト部門に関する多様な案件を扱います。深いサポート精神のもと、柔軟にかつ迅速に動けるチームとして、PayPayのあらゆる案件の事業をサポートしていくチームです。
プロダクト部門とは基本的に英語でのコミュニケーションになります（特にreadingとwriting）。日常的に開発部門と会話をするため、ITパスポートなど基礎的なシステム知識も求められます。社内関係先は幅広く、案件も多岐にわたるため、自分が詳しくない領域の仕事も担当します。単に伝える・理解する以上のコミュニケーションを意識する必要があります。ゴールや目的を正しく理解し、何事にも興味をもち、前向きに取り組むサポート精神が求められます。

▼募集の背景
急激な事業拡大が進む一方で、PayPayシステムや外部連携システムは複雑化しています。24時間365日サービスを提供し続ける中で起きるシステムトラブルの原因究明から復旧までビジネスとプロダクト部門のエンジニアの架け橋となり問題解決を行う迅速に行うために、プロダクトサポートがあります。高い技術力と多くのステークホルダーと円滑に調整を進められるプロフェッショナル人材が不足しており組織強化目的の実現に向けた募集となります。

【具体的な業務内容】
関係部署とコミュニケーションを取りながらプロダクト部門と連携して、PayPayのプロダクトに関するエスカレーション対応、障害発生時の対応、改善提案を行う部門となります。

・CSや営業部門で解決できずあがってくるエスカレーションに対して問題の切り分け、プロダクト部門と連携し問題解決を推進する
・障害発生時、プロダクト部門と連携し問題の切り分けや社内外への障害報告を行い障害解消までの推進を行う
・日々のエスカレーションやユーザーの声を元にプロダクト部門へ改善提案を行いユーザー体験の向上を実現する
・社内ツールの権限付与やデータ抽出、更新作業を行う
・監査・リスクアセスメントへの障害報告資料の作成〜報告

▼本ポジションの魅力

・仕事を通じてPayPayサービスや仕様にもっとも広く・詳しくなれることができるのが本ポジションの魅力となります
・プロダクト部門とビジネス部門双方と関係を持ち課題解決できるため両方の知識や経験が得られます
・24時間365日サービスを支え続けるポジションであり時に大変ではあるが非常に責任あるやりがいのあることが魅力となります

必要な経験/スキル

・ＡＩ活用の経験
・自発的に学習し、常に最新のテクノロジーを取り入れる意欲のある方
・英語力（メールや社内チャット等で、文章のやり取りが可能なレベル。AIによる自動翻訳の支援もあります）
-エンジニアやプロダクトマネージャとは、英語でコミュニケーションが必要になります
・複数のステークホルダーと折衝し、合理的な解決策に導く能力
・良好なチームワークを形成でき円滑に業務を遂行できる方
・本拠地およびCS拠点（東京四谷、博多、小倉、札幌）への出社・出張が問題ないこと

【スキル】
-ITパスポート、基本情報技術者などのスキル
-SQLを活用したデータ抽出の経験
-WEBアプリケーション開発保守運用の経験は歓迎
-ログ調査ができる方

【求める人材】
-主体的に取り組める方
-常に相手の目線に立って丁寧で繊細な仕事ができる方
-困っている人のために役に立ちたいと考えられる方

あると望ましい経験/スキル

・出社およびリモートの組み合わせに対する受容性・適性

・システムエンジニアの経験
-プロジェクトマネージメント（開発～リリースまでの開発チームの管理）スキル
-API仕様書を理解して要件を定義できるテクニカルスキル
-社内業務システムの開発を企画した経験

・システム監視業務の経験（24時間365日）
-システム監視業務〜障害時の復旧対応〜関係者への報告など
-障害レベルに応じたサービスレベル品質の構築
-障害対応手順のドキュメント整備、標準化の経験

PayPayが求める人物像

待遇・条件

勤務地

勤務時間

jobs.title: Product Security Engineer
jobs.description:
The Product Security Engineer is a hands-on security engineer embedded with Penumbra’s software development teams. 
This role helps teams build security into products from design through release by implementing the NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF). 
The role also owns day-to-day product security and HIPAA compliance activities for Penumbra’s product software and connected products. 
The Product Security Engineer works side by side with developers, architects, quality, and regulatory teams to find and fix security issues early and to produce the evidence needed to demonstrate compliance.
Specific Duties and Responsibilities
• Work embedded within product development teams as the primary security resource, participating in planning, design reviews, code reviews, and release activities.
• Implement and operationalize the NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF, SP 800-218) across the product development lifecycle, including defining practices, tooling, and evidence for each phase.
• Perform threat modeling and security architecture reviews for new products, features, and significant changes, document risks, and recommend mitigations. 
• Integrate and tune security testing in CI/CD pipelines, including static and dynamic application security testing (SAST/DAST), software composition analysis (SCA), secrets scanning, and container and infrastructure-as-code scanning.
• Triage security findings with developers, validate fixes, and track product vulnerabilities through remediation within defined timelines.
• Own product HIPAA security compliance activities, including risk analyses, safeguard mapping, and documentation for products that create, receive, maintain, or transmit protected health information (PHI).
• Generate and maintain software bills of materials (SBOMs) and manage third-party and open-source component risk.
• Support product security documentation for regulatory submissions, customer security questionnaires, and audits, in partnership with quality and regulatory teams.
• Develop secure coding standards and guidance and deliver practical security training to developers.
• Support coordinated vulnerability disclosure and product security incident response, including investigation, remediation, and customer communication in partnership with other teams.
• Conduct or coordinate penetration testing of products and applications and manage findings through to closure.
• Track and report product security metrics (e.g., open vulnerabilities by severity, time to remediate, SSDF practice adoption).
• Adhere to the Company’s Quality Management System (QMS) as well as domestic and global quality system regulations, standards, and procedures.
• Understand relevant security, privacy, and compliance principles and adhere to the regulations, standards, and procedures that are applicable to the Company.
• Ensure other members of the department follow the QMS, regulations, standards, and procedures.
• Perform other work-related duties as assigned.
Position Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Security, or related field with 5+ years of experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
• Preferred certifications in any of the following: Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional (CSSLP), GIAC Web Application Penetration Tester (GWAPT), Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP), or Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP).
• 5+ years of experience in application security, product security, or software engineering, including hands-on security work within a development environment.
• Software development background with the ability to read and review code in one or more modern languages (e.g., C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, C/C++, Python, Java).
• Practical knowledge of the NIST SSDF, OWASP Top 10, OWASP ASVS or SAMM, and secure design principles.
• Hands-on experience with application security tooling (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning) and CI/CD platforms (e.g., GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Jenkins).
• Experience with threat modeling methodologies (e.g., STRIDE) and security architecture reviews.
• Working knowledge of HIPAA Security Rule requirements and safeguarding PHI in software products.
• Experience securing cloud-hosted applications and APIs (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including identity, secrets management, and encryption.
• Familiarity with medical device cybersecurity expectations (e.g., FDA premarket cybersecurity guidance, SBOM requirements, IEC 81001-5-1, AAMI TIR57) is highly desirable.
• Experience working within a regulated quality system (e.g., ISO 13485 or FDA quality system requirements) is a plus.
• Ability to build trust with developers and influence without authority, with a pragmatic approach that balances risk with delivery.
• Strong oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
• Proficiency with MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
• Excellent organizational skills with the ability to prioritize assignments while handling various projects simultaneously.
Working Conditions
• General office/hybrid environment.
• Willingness and ability to work on site.
• Requires some lifting and moving of up to 5 pounds.
• Must be able to move between buildings and floors.
• Must be able to remain stationary and use a computer or other standard office equipment, such as a printer or copy machine, for an extensive period of time each day.
• Must be able to read, prepare emails, and produce documents and spreadsheets.
• Must be able to move within the office and access file cabinets or supplies, as needed.
• Must be able to communicate and exchange accurate information with employees at all levels on a daily basis.
Annual Base Salary Range:  $145,000 - $215,000   
We offer a competitive compensation package plus a benefits and equity program, when applicable. 
Individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location.

jobs.title: Senior Telephony Engineer
jobs.description:
Here at Ooma we empower people to connect in smarter ways. We do this by creating powerful communication experiences through our cloud-based platform to bring people together at work and at home. Our solutions help small business owners stay connected with their customers and manage their businesses from anywhere. For larger companies we provide customized unified communications solutions to meet their unique needs. At home, we help our customers connect with their loved ones by providing the #1 rated VoIP phone service available. We also provide them with peace of mind through our innovative smart home security solution. At Ooma, all our products and services are priced competitively, because we believe advanced technology should be accessible to all.

About the Role:

As Senior Telephony Engineer, you’ll own the technical direction and reliability of Phone.com’s voice platform, helping business customers stay connected. You’ll combine hands-on engineering with architecture and technical leadership across our voice, cloud, and data center infrastructure.

Working with a small team of engineers and contractors, you’ll guide technical decisions, improve performance, and strengthen platform resilience through automation, documentation, and tested recovery plans.

What You’ll Do:

• Lead the design and optimization of the Kamailio, OpenSIPS, and FreeSWITCH SIP platform, including call routing, registration, and media handling.

• Own SIP trunking, carrier integrations, and least-cost and failover routing across carriers.

• Set technical standards, review designs and code, and make architecture decisions for voice services.

• Own reliability, monitoring, alerting, and capacity planning for data center servers and multi-region AWS environments.

• Design and test failover and disaster recovery for session border controllers, proxies, media servers, and carrier links.

• Monitor call quality and platform health, including MOS, jitter, packet loss, and answer-seizure ratio; lead corrective action, incident response, and blameless postmortems, and participate in the on-call rotation.

• Plan telephony software upgrades, patching, and data center hardware lifecycle management.

• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible; improve observability with Prometheus, Grafana, logs, and packet captures, and apply automation and AI-assisted troubleshooting to reduce detection and resolution time.

• Direct the day-to-day technical work of the VoIP engineer and code and DevOps contractors; maintain architecture documentation, runbooks, and change records to eliminate dependence on any one person.

• Manage carrier and infrastructure vendors, including SLAs, escalations, and technical evaluations; partner with product, support, NOC, and security teams on releases, incidents, and PCI DSS, SOC 2, and HIPAA compliance.

Experience We’re Looking For:

• 8+ years of voice, telecom, or infrastructure engineering experience is required, including production operations for carrier-grade or highly available services.

• This role requires hands-on production experience with Kamailio or OpenSIPS and FreeSWITCH, deep knowledge of SIP, SDP, and RTP, and the ability to troubleshoot signaling and media issues using packet captures and logs.

• Candidates need experience designing and operating multi-region AWS environments—including IAM, VPC networking, compute, containers, and Lambda—and running production Linux at scale with containerized workloads and Kubernetes or equivalent.

• Experience with Ansible and CI/CD pipelines is required; Python or Bash scripting for automation and tooling is preferred.

• Working knowledge of BGP, OSPF, and carrier interconnects is required.

• Candidates need experience setting technical direction and reviewing engineers’ or contractors’ work, along with clear written and verbal communication during incidents and with vendors.

• A bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent experience, is required.

• Experience owning data center operations during a cloud migration, including hardware lifecycle and capacity planning, is preferred, as is a track record of reducing infrastructure costs through right-sizing, containers, or serverless services.

• Experience building an observability platform or Network Operations Center using Prometheus, Grafana, or similar tools is preferred. Experience applying LLM-assisted troubleshooting, AIOps, or retrieval-augmented generation to operations is also preferred.

• Experience supporting PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA controls on communications platforms is preferred, as is experience with emergency calling (911 and E911) or other regulated telephony obligations.

• AWS Solutions Architect, CCNA, Juniper, or Asterisk certifications are preferred.

What We Offer:

Working at Ooma means being a team player, while allowing your individual voice to come through. And, you'll receive competitive compensation, benefits and generous company perks.

• Comprehensive Medical/Dental/Vision insurance for you and eligible dependents HMO, PPO’s or a PPO with a HDHP (including HSA, which Ooma helps fund)

• Employer Paid Income Protection Benefits (Basic Life and AD&D, Short- and Long-term disability)

• FSA Healthcare & Dependent Care

• Commuter Benefits

• Voluntary Accident, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity and Legal

• 401(k), including employer match, and Roth

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

• Paid Time off, Sick Time, as well as corporate holidays observed

• Employee Assistance Program

• Life Balance benefits with Travel Assistance Services and Identity Theft

• Additional Benefits include a Discount Program, Credit Union, Medicare Assistance, etc. #LI-CC1

Ooma is an equal-opportunity employer committed to recruiting, employing, retaining, promoting, and otherwise treating all employees on the basis of merit, qualifications, and competence. We do not discriminate on the basis of any trait or characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

All interviews are conducted via video. To be considered for a role, candidates must participate in all interviews with their camera enabled, subject to reasonable accommodation. Candidates who need an accommodation should contact their recruiter.

We may utilize AI-enabled tools during the hiring process, including for resume review, scheduling, and interview note-taking or transcription. These tools are used solely to support our hiring team; all employment decisions are made by human reviewers.

Where interviews are recorded or transcribed, candidates will be notified in advance and their consent will be obtained.

The base salary range for candidates within the United States is listed below. Actual base pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, specific location, etc. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Regular employees may also be eligible for bonus(es), sales incentive(s) (target included in OTE) and/or stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

United States Pay Range

$110,000—$150,000 USD

jobs.title: Customer Success Specialist, Renewals & Growth
jobs.location: Denver, CO; Seattle, WA; Remote, US
jobs.description:
Role Purpose

LevelTen Energy's mission is to accelerate the energy transition by facilitating frictionless transactions. As the leading provider of renewable transaction infrastructure, we deliver the cloud-based software, centralized supply, automated analytics, and transaction expertise required to power the renewable energy economy. The LevelTen Platform is the world's largest online hub for renewable energy buyers, sellers, advisors, asset owners and financiers, and delivers the online tools and expertise they need to buy, sell and finance assets quickly.

The Account Specialist, Base Developer Renewals & Growth owns the renewal and expansion of LevelTen's Base developer clients — renewable project developers on entry-level platform packages. This role is accountable for retaining these clients, helping them get more value from the LevelTen Platform with minimal support overhead, and growing them into higher-tier packages.

This is a high-volume, scalable role. The Account Specialist will run a programmatic engagement model for the majority of accounts — onboarding, usage nudges, renewal cadences and marketing-supported campaigns — while giving higher-touch attention to the accounts with the strongest upsell potential. As a fast-growing company in a quickly evolving industry, we are always learning and improving how we support our customers, and this role will help design the playbook for how LevelTen serves and grows its Base client segment.

Duties and Responsibilities

Duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Renewals & Retention

• Own the full renewal cycle for a large portfolio of Base developer accounts, from early renewal outreach through signed agreement

• Forecast renewals accurately in Salesforce and flag at-risk accounts early with a plan to save them

• Track platform usage and engagement signals to spot churn risk and intervene before renewal

• Hit gross and net revenue retention targets for the Base developer segment

Growth & Upsell

• Identify and close upsell opportunities, moving Base clients into higher-tier platform packages and add-on products

• Show developers the value of LevelTen services so they participate more actively in LevelTen marketplaces, RFPs and auctions

• Partner with Marketing on scalable campaigns (webinars, product updates, market insights) that drive adoption and expansion

• Hand off qualified larger opportunities to senior Account Managers and Transactions teams

Scaled Engagement & Enablement

• Onboard new Base clients on the LevelTen Platform and explain LevelTen's offline products and services

• Build self-serve resources (guides, FAQs, templates) so clients can answer routine questions without heavy support

• Triage inbound questions from Base clients and route them to the right internal team

• Support PPA and M&A transactions (RFPs and auctions), including notifying developers, providing updates, and sharing won/lost and developer report feedback

Program Building

• Help design and refine the Base client coverage model, renewal playbook and engagement cadence

• Define and report on segment KPIs (renewal rate, upsell revenue, platform usage) to leadership

• Work cross-functionally with Client Support, Product, Marketing and Transactions to improve the Base client experience

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have:

• 3+ years of experience in account management, customer success, renewals or SaaS sales, ideally in energy software and/or energy

• Experience managing a book of ~60 accounts and meeting or exceeding renewal and upsell goals

• Comfort running scaled, programmatic engagement (email sequences, campaigns, usage-based outreach) alongside 1:1 relationships

• Clear written and verbal communication, comfortable presenting to customers, and attention to detail

• Strong organization and the ability to manage many accounts and deadlines at once

• Proficiency with Salesforce and BI/analytics tools

• Able to manage your own book of accounts, set priorities, and ask for input when needed

• Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with a variety of internal groups

• Ability to travel domestically [20%]

Additional Details

• The estimated compensation for this position is $110,000 – $140,000 per year, (OTE $130,000 - $165,000) based on experience and qualifications.

Benefits / Perks

• Full medical, vision and dental coverage

• Wellness credit

• Flexible vacation policy

• 11 paid company holidays

• 401(k) plan

About LevelTen Energy

LevelTen Energy is the leading provider of transaction infrastructure for the renewable energy economy. Our platform delivers buyers, sellers, advisors, and financiers the automation software, data management, and standardized contracts needed to facilitate faster, safer renewable energy transactions. LevelTen's marketplace of renewable energy power purchase agreements is the world's largest, with more than 4,000 Transaction-Ready Pricing™ offers spanning 21 countries in North America and Europe. LevelTen's CFO-Ready Analytics™ automatically calculate more than a billion data points every day, providing our partners with leading-edge, real-time risk and value insights at modern market scale. Together, LevelTen and our partners share #OneGoal to accelerate the clean energy transition. Visit us at LevelTenEnergy.com to learn more.

Equal Opportunity Employer

LevelTen Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other legally protected status.

Accessibility

If you are an individual with a disability and need assistance completing the online application or during the interview process, please call 1-800-995-2152. Please leave a message and a member of our People team will return your call within three business days. Alternatively, an email may be sent to hr@leveltenenergy.com. “Applicant Accommodation” should be included in the subject line of the email. Please note that this phone number and email are only for those individuals who would like to request an accommodation to apply for a job.

jobs.title: Team Lead - Anti-Reflective-Day Shift
jobs.location: Salt Lake City, UT, United States
jobs.description:
Shift:

Monday - Thursday 5 AM - 3:30 PM (Peak hours) (Overtime on Friday during peak season)

$19.63/hr. + production bonus eligible

What You'll Do:

• Invoice Inspection: Utilize your keen eye to read invoices and directing trays accordingly.
• Lens Handling: Visually pre-inspect lenses, loading them into sectors, and placing sectors into machines with precision.
• Chemical Management: Skillfully place the proper chemicals into the right pockets after each phase of the process, ensuring a seamless production flow.
• Quality Assurance: Lift sectors out of machines, download lenses back into trays, and meticulously match numbers on paperwork to guarantee accuracy.
• Lens Maintenance: Clean lenses thoroughly with lens cleaner and cloth, removing all polish and ensuring compliance with ANSI standards.
• Workflow Optimization: Separate jobs between departments, lead associates to ensure optimal workflow, and operate the AR Coating Machine.
• Training and Development: Train new associates, conduct Professional Improvement Plans, and collaborate with the AR Supervisor to enhance performance and the work environment.

• Education: No specific education level required; however, the ability to read and write English is essential.
• Experience: Minimum of 1 year in a related field or lesser jobs, either within or outside the organization.
• Skills: Ability to follow simple instructions, perform with accuracy, and engage in intermittent sustained mental effort.

Physical Job Requirements:

• Mobility: Continuous walking, standing, or sitting based on the production station.
• Manual Dexterity: Frequent movement and twisting of the wrist, repetitive movement of hands and fingers.
• Lifting: Frequently lifts, carries, or moves objects weighing 0-10 lbs.
• Flexibility: Frequent bending and twisting of the neck, occasional bending at the waist.
• Safety Measures: Gloves and protective eyewear must be worn during work periods.

We understand the importance of financial health and security, and because of that, we provide competitive compensation to all Associates – including bonus potential for every position in the store! jobs.title: Senior Digital Product Manager
jobs.description:
The Senior Digital Product Manager is responsible for shaping, delivering, and continuously improving digital products that create meaningful customer experiences and measurable business value. This role owns the product vision, roadmap, prioritization, and performance of digital capabilities across web, mobile, eCommerce, omnichannel, and internal platforms. The ideal candidate combines customer empathy, analytical discipline, technical fluency, and strong cross-functional leadership to turn business goals and user needs into successful digital solutions.

What Would You Do? The Specifics.

• Define and maintain the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for assigned digital products.
• Translate customer needs, business objectives, market trends, and data insights into prioritized product requirements and user stories.
• Own and manage the product backlog, balancing customer impact, revenue opportunity, operational needs, technical feasibility, and delivery capacity.
• Partner closely with UX, engineering, analytics, marketing, operations, merchandising, customer support, legal, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality digital experiences.
• Lead product discovery activities, including customer research, competitive analysis, journey mapping, usability testing, and opportunity sizing.
• Drive agile ceremonies and delivery alignment, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, acceptance criteria, release readiness, and post-launch validation.
• Use data, experimentation, A/B testing, and performance reporting to identify opportunities, measure outcomes, and continuously improve product performance.
• Coordinate go-to-market planning, launch communications, stakeholder training, and adoption support for new digital capabilities.
• Monitor product health, customer feedback, defects, accessibility considerations, and operational issues; prioritize enhancements and fixes accordingly.
• Communicate roadmap progress, trade-offs, risks, dependencies, and results clearly to executive leaders and cross-functional partners.

Work Experience

• 6+ years in product management, digital product ownership, eCommerce, technology delivery, UX, business analysis, or a related discipline ((Required))
• Demonstrated experience managing digital products through the full lifecycle, from discovery and requirements through launch, optimization, and ongoing support. ((Required))
• Experience using analytics tools and product performance data to inform prioritization and decision-making. ((Required))
• Experience with eCommerce, omnichannel retail, customer account platforms, scheduling, checkout, payments, personalization, search, or digital marketing capabilities. ((Preferred))
• Experience with conversion rate optimization, funnel analysis, customer journey analytics, SEO, accessibility, privacy, or experimentation programs. ((Preferred))

Education

• Four year college degree or equivalent experience. in product management, digital product ownership, eCommerce, technology delivery, UX, business analysis, or a related discipline (Required)

Licenses, Certifications, Professional Affiliations

• Certified Scrum Product Owner, Product Management certification, Agile certification Upon Hire ((Preferred))

Additional Skills

• Strong understanding of agile delivery practices, user stories, acceptance criteria, sprint planning, and backlog management. (Required)
• Ability to work effectively with technical teams and translate complex concepts into clear business and customer outcomes. (Required)
• Excellent communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. (Required)
• Customer-first mindset with a strong ability to understand user needs and pain points. (Required)
• Strategic thinking with the ability to connect product decisions to business outcomes. (Required)
• Analytical rigor and comfort working with quantitative and qualitative insights. (Required)
• Strong collaboration skills across business, technology, creative, and operational teams. (Required)
• Ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment with competing demands. (Required)
• Clear, concise communication for both executive and delivery-team audiences. (Required)
• Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Figma, GA4/GA360, Adobe Analytics, ContentSquare, Optimizely, or similar platforms. (Preferred)

Taking Care of our People!

We understand the importance of financial health and security, and because of that, we provide competitive compensation to all associates.
