jobs.description:
Position Summary...

The Walmart Last Mile Delivery Internship is an 11-week paid internship program designed to provide students with hands-on experience solving meaningful business problems at scale. Interns will work on high-impact projects, collaborate with cross-functional teams and senior leaders, network with industry experts, and develop skills while experiencing Walmart’s Home Office in Northwest Arkansas.

As part of the Last Mile Delivery team, the intern will have the opportunity to help shape the next generation of platform stability and change management for Spark Driver—using AI, automation, data, and new ways of working to identify and prevent issues before they impact drivers.

About Last Mile Delivery

Walmart Last Mile Delivery is responsible for building and operating the capabilities that connect customers with their orders during the final stage of the delivery journey.

A critical part of this ecosystem is Spark Driver, Walmart’s platform connecting independent drivers with delivery opportunities. Providing a reliable driver experience requires coordination across product, engineering, operations, analytics, communications, and support teams to ensure that new capabilities are tested effectively, launched safely, monitored in real time, and quickly improved when issues arise.

The Driver Experience organization works across this ecosystem to identify friction, improve platform reliability, and create a more seamless experience for drivers at scale.

What you'll do...

Role Summary

The Last Mile Delivery Intern will support the Next-Gen Rewards, Loyalty & Engagement Ecosystem ("Perks Orbit"), a strategic initiative focused on reimagining how Spark recognizes, rewards, and engages drivers.

Today, loyalty programs often rely on traditional tier-based structures. This project will explore how Spark's rewards ecosystem can evolve into a more dynamic and modular platform—a flexible "perks orbit" of incentives, benefits, recognition, partnerships, and experiences that can adapt to different driver needs and behaviors.

The intern will help define a future-state rewards and engagement strategy that considers how rewards should evolve across driver lifecycle stages, behaviors, needs, and segments. The work will also explore how rewards, communications, and engagement moments can operate cohesively to strengthen driver loyalty, encourage desired behaviors, and improve long-term engagement and retention.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous strategic problems, understanding customer or user behavior, using data to develop insights, and translating those insights into practical product and business recommendations.

What You’ll Learn

• How a large-scale gig delivery platform attracts, engages, and retains drivers

• How loyalty and rewards programs can influence user behavior and engagement

• How customer and driver insights are translated into product and business strategies

• How segmentation, lifecycle management, and personalization can create differentiated experiences

• How partnerships and experiential benefits can expand a traditional loyalty ecosystem

• How product, operations, analytics, marketing, communications, and strategy teams collaborate to launch new experiences

• How strategic concepts are tested, prioritized, and translated into an actionable roadmap

Qualifications

• Currently pursuing a master’s or graduate degree in Business, Strategy, Marketing, Economics, Analytics, Product Management, Operations, or a related field

• Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills

• Ability to synthesize quantitative and qualitative information into clear insights

• Curiosity about consumer behavior, loyalty, marketplaces, gig economy platforms, or digital products

• Comfortable working with data and using tools such as Excel/Sheets; experience with analytics or visualization tools is a plus

• Ability to structure and solve ambiguous problems

• Strong written, verbal, and executive communication skills

• Collaboration-first working style with the ability to work across multiple functions

• Innovation-driven mindset and interest in developing new customer or user experiences

• Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment

Office Environment

Corporate, in-person internship

Job Location

Bentonville, AR

Pay is based on several factors which vary based on position. These include labor markets and in some instances may include education, work experience and certifications. ALL ABOUT TARGET

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.

ALL ABOUT SERVICE & ENGAGEMENT

Advocates of guest experience who welcome, thank, and exceed guest service expectations by focusing on guest interaction and recovery. Advocates of both in-store and digital services and solutions who are knowledgeable about capabilities and features that drive adoption, usage and ultimately guest loyalty. Empowered to make shopping quick and easy for guests at the checklanes, guest services, gift registry, pick-up and drive up while ensuring exceptional quality.

At Target, we believe in our leaders having meaningful experiences that help them build and develop skills for a career. The role of a Service and Engagement Team Leader can provide you with the skills and experience of:

• Guest service fundamentals and experience building a guest-first culture and driving loyalty programs

• Guest engagement, problem solving and resolution

• Retail business fundamentals, including department sales trends, inventory management, guest shopping patterns, pricing and promotions strategies

• Planning department(s) daily/weekly workload to support business priorities and deliver service and sales goals

• Leading a team of hourly team members, including skills in interviewing, developing, coaching, evaluating and retaining talent

As a Service and Engagement Team Leader, no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will most likely include the following responsibilities:

• Consistently deliver guest experience commitments to create an Easy, Inspiring and Friendly guest experience.

• Ensures every team member understands, is trained, and consistently delivers on Target’s guest experience commitments and consistent operations.

• Actively observes and provides feedback, holding team members accountable while recognizing great guest experience moments.

• Reviews area guest, financial, and team outcome metrics to identify opportunities, takes action to improve, and aligns team on the right behaviors and execution, celebrates wins, drives results that deliver outcomes and elevates the guest experience.

• Demonstrate inclusivity by valuing diverse voices and approaches, being authentic and respectful, and creating equitable experiences.

• Lead a team of passionate and knowledgeable Guest Advocates, Service Advocates and Front of Store Attendants who strive to exceed guest service expectations by focusing on decreasing wait time, friendly guest interactions, quality of service, resolution, driving loyalty and cleanliness standards.

• Lead and demonstrate a culture of executing all best practices as outlined with team onboarding and learning; help close skill gaps through development, coaching and team interactions.

• Understand sales goals, business reporting and guest insights to plan and execute daily/weekly workload, to deliver on store sales goals, guest engagement and troubleshoot opportunity areas as needed throughout the day.

• Support Target Loyalty Programs to ensure your team can educate and promote the suite of benefits, features and offerings that reward our guest and enhance their shopping experience.

• Support your direct leader by following up on training completion, checking for understanding and supporting continuous education opportunities to drive proficiencies for all front of store experiences.

• With guidance from your direct leader, engage in consistent, meaningful development conversations throughout the critical touch points within the team's career path.

• Personalize recognition and appreciation of your team to reinforce critical guest service behaviors and promote a positive team and guest-centric culture.

• With guidance from your direct leader, help lead a culture of accountability through clear expectations and performance management (listen, observe, recognize and coach) on critical Service and Engagement behaviors.

• Quickly respond to any concerns with guests’ shopping experience by de-escalating the situation and ensuring your team understands and feels supported to resolve or address guest concerns and issues.

• Ensure your team members stay up-to-date on upcoming major promotions, brand launches and events.

• Evaluate candidates for open positions and develop a guest-centric team as directed by your direct leader.

• Support and enable team members to deliver pick up and drive up orders (including drive up returns and Starbucks) efficiently and accurately to digital guests, following all federal, state and local adult beverage laws. Support guest services as needed.

• Demonstrate a culture of ethical conduct and compliance; lead team to work in the same way and hold others accountable to this commitment.

• Lead and demonstrate a safety culture through modeling and recognizing safe behaviors, identifying and correct hazards, holding team accountable to following safety expectations, assisting with incident response, and reporting/investigating injuries timely and accurately.

• Model the execution of physical security processes in order to enhance the instore security culture.

• Support merchandise protection strategies across the total store, including ordering, storage and application as directed by best practices.

• If applicable, as a key carrier, follow all safe and secure training and processes.

• Occasionally assume store-level leadership on duty (LOD) responsibilities to enable the guest experience for the store during assigned shifts based on store needs.

• Address all store emergency and compliance needs.

• All other duties based on business needs.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

This may be the right job for you if:

• You enjoy interacting and helping others - including guests that shop our store and fellow team members you work with.

• You thrive in a fast-moving, highly active and physically demanding role, where teamwork, flexibility, and creative problem solving are key to success.

• You are open to working a variable work schedule with varying hours, days or shifts (including nights, weekends, holidays, closing shifts and other peak shopping times).

The good news is that we have some amazing training that will help teach you everything you need to know to be a Service and Engagement Team Leader. But, there are a few skills you should have from the get-go:

• High school diploma or equivalent

• Must be at least 18 years of age or older

• Previous retail experience preferred, but not required

• Lead and hold others accountable

• Ability to communicate on multiple frequency devices and operate handheld scanners, and other technology equipment as directed

• Work independently and as part of a team

• Manage workload and prioritize tasks independently and with a team

• Welcoming and helpful attitude toward all guests and other team members

• Effective communication skills

• Capability to remain focused and composed in a fast-paced environment and accomplish multiple tasks within established timeframes

We are an awesome place to work and care about our teams, so we want to make sure we are clear on a few more basics that we expect:

• Access all areas of the building to respond to guest or team member issues

• Interpret instructions, reports and information

• Accurately handle cash register operations, cash transactions, and oversee cash office processes as needed

• Scan, handle and move merchandise efficiently and safely, including frequently lifting or moving merchandise up to 44 pounds without additional assistance from others

• Climb up and down ladders as needed

• Flexible work schedule (e.g., nights, weekends and holidays) and reliable and prompt attendance necessary

• Although the role is full-time, it does not come with a guarantee of 40 hours each week. Hours will depend on the needs of the business and may fluctuate as required

• Capable of working in and exposure to varying temperatures, humidity, and other elements while performing certain job duties including but not limited to Drive-Up, carryout, etc. as needed

• Ability to remain mobile for the duration of a scheduled shift (shift length may vary)

Target will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the San Francisco and City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinances.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about driving sourcing excellence and continuous process improvement?

Do you enjoy optimizing sourcing processes, leveraging technology and ERP systems, and partnering with stakeholders to deliver operational efficiency and business value?

Partnering with the Best

As a Sourcing Specialist, you will support sourcing operations through process ownership, continuous improvement initiatives, and project execution. You will collaborate with sourcing teams and business stakeholders to enhance processes, improve operational effectiveness, and drive impactful sourcing outcomes.

Fueling Your Passion

As a Sourcing Specialist, you will leverage your sourcing expertise, analytical capabilities, and problem-solving skills to improve sourcing processes and operational performance. You will work closely with colleagues and stakeholders to identify improvement opportunities, support sourcing initiatives, and contribute to projects that deliver measurable business results.

As a Sourcing Specialist, you will be responsible for:

• Owning and supporting sourcing-related ERP systems, processes, and tools to drive operational excellence.
• Reviewing existing sourcing procedures and identifying opportunities for process optimization and continuous improvement.
• Developing and implementing proposals to improve sourcing approaches, methods, procedures, and workflows.
• Supporting special sourcing initiatives and operational improvement projects.
• Collaborating with sourcing teams and business stakeholders to coordinate sourcing activities and deliver effective solutions.
• Handling communication with direct colleagues and business partners regarding sourcing processes, improvements, and project deliverables.
• Contributing as an active team member on sourcing projects and cross-functional initiatives.
• Supporting the execution of work plans and projects with timelines typically ranging from one to three months.
• Monitoring project outcomes and ensuring results are delivered efficiently and effectively.
• Promoting best practices and operational efficiencies across sourcing activities.

To be successful in this role, you will:

• Have a bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college.
• Have 4–6 years of experience in Sourcing, Procurement, Supply Chain, or a related field.
• Demonstrate experience working with sourcing systems, ERP platforms, and sourcing processes.
• Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and implement process improvements.
• Demonstrate experience supporting projects and driving operational initiatives.
• Have the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
• Possess strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and organizational levels.

Desired Characteristics

• Strong oral and written communication skills.
• Strong interpersonal and leadership skills.
• Ability to work independently and take ownership of sourcing processes and initiatives.
• Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities.
• Demonstrated ability to identify and drive process improvements.
• Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders.
• Strong project coordination and execution skills.
• Commitment to continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Work in a Way That Works for You

This role requires close collaboration with sourcing teams, business stakeholders, and cross-functional partners to support sourcing operations, process enhancements, and project execution. The position offers opportunities to contribute to initiatives that improve efficiency, standardization, and overall sourcing performance.

Working with Us

Our people are at the heart of our success. We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and performance-driven environment where innovation, teamwork, professional development, and continuous improvement are encouraged and rewarded.

Working for You

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package designed to support your professional growth and well-being, which may include:

• Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities.
• Comprehensive private medical care options.
• Safety net of life insurance and disability programs.
• Tailored financial programs and additional elected or voluntary benefits.

jobs.description:

作为我们普药事业部的医学信息沟通代表，您将加入团队，转变全球慢性病和特药疾病的医疗保健服务方式。在 General Medicines 中，您将帮助推动糖尿病、移植和免疫学领域取得有意义的成果—以患者应得的规模和紧迫性。准备好开始了吗？

我们是一家以研发为驱动、以AI为动力的生物制药公司，致力于改善人们的生活并实现令人信服的增长。我们对免疫系统的深入理解以及创新的产品管线使我们能够发明药物和疫苗，为全球数百万人提供治疗和保护。我们共同追寻科学的奇迹，改善人们的生活。

jobs.title: VP Investor Relations
jobs.description:
About the Role:

Grade Level (for internal use):

15

The Team:

Based in New York, S&P Global’s Investor Relations team is responsible for all communication with shareholders and analysts. This includes the preparation of quarterly earnings materials, assisting in the preparation of SEC filings (forms 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, etc.), and direct engagement with the investor community. This is a critical team, working very closely with the Executive Leadership Team and the Board of Directors.

What’s in it For You:

• S&P Global has consistently been recognized by Extel (formerly Institutional Investor) with top sector honors, including #1 IR Team, #1 IR Program, #1 IR Professional, and #1 IR events.
• Lead at the center of a premier global market benchmark and financial intelligence enterprise, with direct exposure to C-suite decision-making and cross-divisional strategy.
• Drive the modernization of investor relations by embedding GenAI, workflow automation, and predictive data analytics directly into our capital markets strategy.
• S&P Global operates with an authentic “People Forward” mindset— with a highly collaborative culture, and a firm commitment to investing in our people’s development.

Responsibilities and Impact:

The Vice President, Investor Relations will report to the SVP, Investor Relations and Treasurer, and will be an essential strategic partner, focused on driving continuous improvement in department initiatives across capital markets deliverables, proactive shareholder engagement, and enterprise narrative.

In this role, success is measured by concrete strategic and operational outcomes:

• Comprehensive Earnings Preparation: Lead process management for quarterly earnings with discipline, rigor, and strong cross-functional coordination. delivering comprehensive executive Q&A preparation, scenario analysis, and draft remarks that enable thorough executive review.
• Forward-Looking Shareholder Targeting: Optimize and oversee a disciplined, data-driven targeting strategy that anticipates investor priorities, deepens engagement with long-term institutional capital, and positions S&P Global for continued strength across domestic and international markets.
• C-Suite & Board Reporting: Optimize and oversee regular reporting to the CEO, CFO, and Board of Directors, including share price performance, peer benchmarking, analysis of the shareholder base, and market sentiment.
• Strategic Finance Modernization: Champion the integration of workflow automation and AI tools, capabilities into consensus tracking, transcript analysis, and competitive intelligence to drive operational efficiency across the team.

Responsibilities:

• Lead the end-to-end development of quarterly earnings collateral, including earnings releases, investor presentations, CEO and CFO prepared remarks, financial reconciliations, and stress-tested Q&A briefing books with disciplined planning, strong cross-functional coordination, and a focus on thorough executive readiness.
• Effectively fill in for the head of Investor Relations at investor events or in investor meetings, as circumstances require - Actively participate in investor meetings independently or alongside the CFO and CEO.
• Optimize and execute proactive institutional investor targeting strategies, establishing measurable conversion pipelines to cultivate new investor relationships and expand equity ownership.
• Build direct, collaborative partnerships with S&P Global business unit leaders to uncover emerging business drivers, pricing dynamics, and market headwinds, ensuring IR messaging remains tightly synchronized with operational reality.
• Lead critical aspects of the planning and execution for major capital markets events, including multi-year Investor Days, thematic teach-ins (e.g., AI initiatives, private markets, energy transition), and governance roadshows.
• Partner with Corporate Communications, Legal, Regulatory, and Financial Reporting teams to ensure seamless consistency and compliance under Reg FD and SEC disclosure standards.
• Be a champion of GenAI, leveraging advanced tools to help automate workflows and improve the speed-to-delivery of financial analytics, consensus tracking, and other regular reports that are distributed to the Board of Directors and other senior leaders.

Compensation/Benefits Information: (This section is only applicable to US candidates)

S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $250,000 to $314,600. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual’s geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses and certifications.

In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan and long-term executive equity incentive opportunities.

This role is eligible to receive additional S&P Global benefits. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please click here.

What We’re Looking For:

Basic Required Qualifications:

• 12+ years of experience in capital markets, with substantial experience in senior corporate Investor Relations, equity research (buy-side or sell-side), or investment banking.
• Demonstrated track record of advising and preparing C-suite executives (CFO, CEO) and engaging executive-level stakeholders.
• Mastery of financial modeling, corporate accounting frameworks, and equity valuation methodologies.
• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to craft compelling investor narratives from complex commercial and financial data.
• Deep knowledge of the financial services, market infrastructure, credit ratings, financial information, or B2B SaaS/data analytics industries.
• Strong leadership and relationship-building capabilities, with a proven ability to collaborate across matrixed business unit leadership and finance functions.
• Experience or strong demonstrated aptitude for leveraging workflow automation, data analytics, and GenAI to improve finance productivity.

What’s In It For You?

Our Mission:

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

Our People:

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

Our Values:
Integrity, Discovery, Partnership

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.

Benefits:

We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That’s why we provide everything you—and your career—need to thrive at S&P Global.

Our benefits include:

• Health & Wellness: Health care coverage designed for the mind and body.
• Flexible Downtime: Generous time off helps keep you energized for your time on.
• Continuous Learning: Access a wealth of resources to grow your career and learn valuable new skills.
• Invest in Your Future: Secure your financial future through competitive pay, retirement planning, a continuing education program with a company-matched student loan contribution, and financial wellness programs.
• Family Friendly Perks: It’s not just about you. S&P Global has perks for your partners and little ones, too, with some best-in class benefits for families.
• Beyond the Basics: From retail discounts to referral incentive awards—small perks can make a big difference.

For more information on benefits by country visit: https://spgbenefits.com/benefit-summaries

Global Hiring and Opportunity at S&P Global:

At S&P Global, we are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all individuals have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. Our hiring practices emphasize fairness, transparency, and merit, ensuring that we attract and retain top talent. By valuing different perspectives and promoting a culture of respect and collaboration, we drive innovation and power global markets.

About the Role:

The Team: Reporting to the VP, Assistant Controller, which oversees Global Accounting and Record to Report, Centre of Excellence Accounting teams, Intercompany Accounting, Internal Reporting and Consolidation, SOX Compliance and Internal Controls.  Overall, you are part of the Chief Accounting Officer’s Accounting Team, which also includes SEC Reporting, Business Unit Controllership, Mergers & Acquisitions Accounting and Real Estate.  The team is a global team.

The Impact: This position critically partners with business and operations to implement change and drive strategic growth, while ensuring the Company’s financial results are in compliance with US GAAP. This position has significant exposure to senior level stakeholders across the organization and involvement with all aspects of the Controllers organization as highlighted in the Team structure above.  This role will be the primary advisor for accounting related matters supporting the different teams within the Chief Accounting Officer’s Accounting organization.

Responsibilities:

The Senior Director of Technical Accounting and Policy is a trusted advisor supporting the Controllers organization as well as the Finance teams across the organization to ensure S&P Global complies with generally accepted accounting principles in the United States of America (“US GAAP”), including adoption of new accounting standards as applicable. You will:

• Prepare documentation and analysis reviewed by the VP, Assistant Controller and become involved in projects, like the application of the US GAAP concepts to hedge accounting, business combinations, investments, equity-based compensation, and revenue recognition to the Company’s transactions.
• Ensure the Company properly applies US GAAP to recurring and non-recurring transactions
• Ensure the Company’s accounting policies and procedures consistently comply with US GAAP
• Evaluate the impact from new accounting standards to the Company’s transaction streams
• Evaluate accounting and reporting impact of potential acquisitions and dispositions, and prepare technical memos to support conclusions
• Work with Legal, Operations, Global Strategy, and Mergers and Acquisitions teams supporting these groups on potential acquisitions and dispositions
• Evaluate processes to identify opportunities for efficiency improvements to meet statutory and regulatory reporting requirements
• Support legal and financial reporting personnel with regulatory filings
• Monitor and respond to the Financial Accounting Standards Board and International Accounting Standards Board exposure drafts in contemplation of their impact on the Company
• Work with operating segments’ Finance teams to apply US GAAP
• Coordinate with other corporate functions to ensure timely accumulation of data and information needed to complete job responsibilities
• Review of other team members’ work
• Ensuring internal controls are performed appropriately and timely

Compensation/Benefits Information: (This section is only applicable to US candidates)

S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $150,481 to $260,000 USD. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual’s geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses and certifications.

In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan.

This role is eligible to receive additional S&P Global benefits. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please click here.

What We’re Looking For:

An individual with strong executive presence and the business acumen to deliberate with senior leaders.  A Trusted Advisor to the Business while also being a strong collaborator who is not opposed to jumping in, rolling up their sleeves and continuous learning.  You consider yourself systems savvy and have worked with Oracle, Alteryx and understand the FinTech industry (or wish to).  An individual with previous experience working on US GAAP concepts associated with revenue recognition, equity-based compensation, hedge accounting, business combinations.

Basic Required Qualifications:

• 8+ years’ experience in Public Accounting, including a thorough understanding of accounting standards generally accepted in the United States and a working understanding of International Financial Reporting Standards
• Proficiency in SEC reporting requirements
• Experience designing and writing technical accounting policies
• Ability to exercise independent direction and judgment
• High degree of problem-solving ability and critical thinking
• This position will need to demonstrate critical thinking in order to properly analyze transactions and effectively communicate results with the Company’s key business managers

Additional Preferred Qualifications:

• Certified Public Accountant or Chartered Accountant
• Bachelor’s degree in Public Accounting, Accounting, or equivalent

jobs.title: Principal Substrate Engineer
jobs.description:
About Marvell

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

Your Team, Your Impact

Marvell Packaging Substrate team is a place where you can brainstorm, excel, innovate, transform for the expansion of AI-driven cloud data centers for a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.  As the substrate engineer, you will have the opportunity to work closely with world class substrate suppliers to execute and deliver cutting edge products.  You will bring your expertise in optimizing ABF substrate manufacturing/process for solutions and will be responsible for developing advanced ABF substrate materials and process optimization to bring products to HVM ramping for all product portfolios.

What You Can Expect

• Drill on each substrate process to solve critical substrate technical problems and quality hiccups in NPIs and HVM products.
• Benchmark, develop, implement new substrate materials into HVM to support advanced node cutting edge silicon products.
• Assess technical capability across all suppliers
• Support substrate TD to tune and optimize each ABF substrate manufacturing/process for advanced substrate technology including embedded substrate, MLC, and advanced substrate materials.
• Be an expert to troubleshoot and support substrate issues on NPIs/HVM and new advanced technology.
• Manage and drive HVM product yield performance
• Manage and drive substrate suppliers on risk assessment, design review and release, BOM and process
• Provide inputs to design guidelines and drive to implement the guidelines.
• Interface substrate suppliers and material suppliers to optimize manufacturing/process and control reliability & quality for NPIs and HVM products.
• Drive substrate NPI design review into timely manufacturing and substrate delivery.
• Execute substrate cycle time, delivery commitment, substrate qualification & reliability tests.
• Provide substrate milestones for NPIs into HVM products.
• Establish the FMEA methodology and spec.
• Manage substrate suppliers and OSAT substrate team for spec alignment including substrate parameters & criteria.
• Work closely with functional teams including NPI, Quality, Assembly, Test, and BU’s.
• Work with QA, OSAT/substrate suppliers to resolve package related quality/reliability issues.

What We're Looking For

• Education: MS/PHD in STEM/Material Science/Mechanical/Chemical Engineering.
• Experience: ABF substate manufacturing/process is a must
• Hands-on expertise and deep knowledge of ABF substrate manufacturing/process is a must.
• Must have FCBGA substrate NPI or technology development experience.
• CoWoS substrate development experience is preferred.
• Deep understanding of semiconductor technologies, substrate materials, reliability standards and failure analysis techniques.
• Strong problem solving, analytical, interpersonal skills are a must.
• Good understanding of advanced technologies including very large body size, embedding, and glass core substrate.
• Knowledge of substrate cost structure and yield management.
• Basic Cadence APD and AutoCAD skills
• Good communication skills that are essential to work well with internal cross functional teams and suppliers.
• Good program and supplier management skills is a must
• Familiar with raw material suppliers is preferred.
• People management experience is a plus.
• Must be self-discipline, flexible, agile, and result driven.

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.

Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements

With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We’re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it’s like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

Interview Integrity

To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews.

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.

This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce and/or the U.S. Department of State. Except for U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.

• Strong knowledge of healthcare systems, go-to-market models, business planning, and analytics.

Enterprise Mindset

Capability Builder

jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Building Information Modeling Coordinator

Company: Loenbro, LLC
Business Unit/Department: Southeast
Location: Atlanta, GA, Huntsville, AL, Nashville, TN/ Remote/Hybrid
Reports to: Pre-job Planning Manager
Employment Type: Full-Time
FLSA Classification: Exempt

About Loenbro

Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries, and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

At Loenbro, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose. Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.

Job Summary

As a Building Information Modeling (BIM) Coordinator assists with managing project BIM processes from design through construction, helping ensure models are accurate and aligned with project requirements. You'll support the implementation of BIM Execution Plans (BEPs), model development, clash detection efforts, and project coordination activities. You'll contribute to maintaining company standards, templates, workflows, and best practices while supporting the timely delivery of project information and continuous improvement initiatives within the BIM department.

Essential Job Responsibilities

• Assist with coordination meetings involving multiple trades, including mechanical, plumbing, telecom, structural, and architectural teams.

• Support Quality Assurance (QA)/Quality Control (QC) reviews, clash detection processes, and issue tracking activities.

• Assist in reviewing model constructability and coordination based on project drawings and system layouts.

• Help ensure project models are updated and synchronized across project teams.

• Support project managers and BIM leads with constructability reviews and field coordination efforts.

• Collaborate with fabrication and field teams to help maintain model accuracy throughout construction.

• Assist with documenting coordination activities and tracking project BIM requirements.

• Learn and apply company BIM standards, workflows, and best practices.

Skills

• Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and manage multiple priorities.

• Basic understanding of construction drawings, building systems, and trade coordination principles.

Qualifications

Required:

• 3+ years of experience in BIM coordination, drafting, modeling, construction technology, or a related field.

• Experience with or exposure to Revit, Navisworks, Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC)/BIM 360, and AutoCAD.

Preferred:

• Associate's degree, technical training, or equivalent experience in construction technology, drafting, engineering technology, or a related field.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Work Environment:

• Indoor office setting with controlled temperature.

• Outdoor industrial sites with exposure to weather extremes.

• Potential exposure to noise, dust, chemicals, or other environmental factors.

• Travel requirements: up to 10% of time.

This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro's Environmental Health and Safety (EH&S) policies.

Benefits

Loenbro offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and rewards to those who join our team:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• 401(k) retirement plan with company match

• Paid time off (PTO)

• Life and disability insurance

• Professional development and training opportunities

• Employee assistance program (EAP)

Benefits eligibility may vary based on employment classification and hours worked.

Guided by Core Values (LEAD), grounded in grit and a commitment to excellence, Loenbro betters our families, customers, and local communities.  If you’re ready to be part of a company that LEADS by:

• Living with Integrity

• Exceeding Expectations

• Acting with Urgency

• Delivering Excellence

…we want to hear from you.

Loenbro is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Lead Medical Assistant
jobs.description:
About Us

Greenbrook Medical is building the new standard in primary care.

We deliver high-touch, relationship-based care through neighborhood clinics, grounded in a simple belief: every senior deserves the kind of care we would want for our own families. Our model prioritizes time with patients, strong care coordination, and a personalized approach that improves outcomes while lowering total cost of care.

We take full accountability for patient outcomes and overall cost of care, aligning clinical excellence with disciplined execution. That commitment shows up in our results, including a patient Net Promoter Score of 90, compared to 32 for typical healthcare organizations.

Rooted in Tampa Bay and partnered with Tampa General Hospital, we are entering an exciting phase of growth. Backed by strong unit economics, experienced operators, and a proven playbook, we are looking for builders and operators who want to help scale a healthcare platform designed to deliver better care, better coordination, and better outcomes for seniors.

About The Role

As a Lead Medical Assistant, you’re the heart of every patient visit and the teammate your clinic counts on to keep things running smoothly.

You’ll do everything our Medical Assistants do, from taking vitals and prepping patients for their provider to making sure every patient feels seen and cared for. All medical assistants are cross-trained across front office, back office, labs and referrals.

As a Lead MA, you’ll also own the results for one clinic-wide area (front office, back office, or lab), like wait times, chart prep, screenings, or HEDIS quality measures. You’ll watch the numbers that matter, find the root cause when something breaks, and fix the process so it doesn’t happen again.

This is hands-on, fast-paced, people-first work with more ownership and independence. You’ll be the go-to teammate for judgment calls and help newer MAs grow. You’ll report to the Center Manager, with a clear path to training new MAs and, over time, Center Manager roles.

Location: Riverview clinic (some local travel may be required to help cover other centers)

Office Hours: Monday–Friday, 8am–5pm

What You’ll Do

Own the patient visit, start to finish

• Take and record vitals, medical histories, and medication lists

• Prep patients for their exam so the provider can focus on care

Handle the hands-on clinical work

• Administer medications, injections, and treatments as directed by the provider

• Draw blood and run lab tests

• Perform EKGs, PFTs, RetinaVue, and other in-clinic tests

Own outcomes for your area of the clinic

• Own the process metrics for one clinic-wide area, such as patient wait times, same-day message routing, chart prep completion, screening backlogs, or HEDIS outcomes

• Monitor results throughout the day and act before small issues become patient problems

• Partner with your Center Manager, providers, and RevOps to keep your area on track

• Excellent at triaging patients to direct them to the appropriate venue of care, reducing unnecessary ED visits

Solve problems, not just tasks

• Find the root cause behind individual patient issues and suggest process fixes that stick

• Handle service recovery, walk-ins, and scheduling judgment calls independently and correctly

• Review teammates’ work in your area (like chart prep, message routing, or EKG quality) and share what you find

Raise the bar for the team

• Be the go-to teammate for advice and judgment calls, and help newer MAs get up to speed

• Help the team adapt to new workflows and tools as we grow

• Pitch in to help cover other areas of the clinic when the team needs you

• Give thoughtful feedback, help resolve disagreements, and take part in hiring new teammates

What Success Looks Like

• The process metrics you own consistently hit target, like wait times, chart prep completion, or HEDIS closure rates

• Your Center Manager steps in less often on service issues, walk-ins, and scheduling

• Process fixes you suggest hold up and get adopted by your teammates

• Teammates seek you out for advice most weeks

• You help sustain a clinic patient NPS of 90+

About You

You bring:

• 4+ years as a medical assistant, ideally in a primary care or value-based care setting

• Have served as a lead, senior, or trainer MA

• Confidence with vitals, blood draws, EKGs, and labs, plus front office and referral workflows

• Experience tracking or improving clinic results, like wait times, chart prep, or quality measures

• Sound judgment, with the ability to work independently and know when to escalate

• A track record of helping teammates learn and making the clinic run better

• Clear, concise communication that builds trust with patients, providers, and teammates

• Composure and professionalism when things get busy

• Genuine warmth and a concierge-level approach to senior care

• A mindset grounded in our core values of Heart, Excellence, Accountability, Resilience, and Teamwork

You stand out if you:

• Are a Certified Medical Assistant (CMA)

• Have experience training new teammates

• Speak both English and Spanish

• Have hands-on experience with HEDIS quality measures and Medicare Advantage plans

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Make An Impact Every Day

Be part of a mission-driven team transforming primary care for seniors. Your work directly supports better outcomes, better coordination, and better experiences for some of the most vulnerable patients in healthcare.

Work That Actually Matters

We’re not a volume-driven system, we’re accountable for outcomes. That means your work directly contributes to quality care, patient satisfaction, and meaningful improvements in how healthcare is delivered.

Build And Grow With Us

We’re building more than a company, we’re building careers. As we expand, you’ll have opportunities to grow your skills and take on new challenges.

Strong, Transparent Compensation & Benefits

• $24-27.50 per hour, based on experience and qualifications

• Generous annual performance bonus

• Health, dental, and vision insurance

• Paid time off + paid sick time

• 401(k) with company match

We believe in fair, equitable pay that reflects your experience and impact.

Show Us Your Excellence

At Greenbrook Medical, excellence shows up in the details. Your resume is our first opportunity to understand your experience and it also reflects how you communicate, organize information, and approach your work.

Please submit a polished resume that demonstrates professionalism and attention to detail. We consider both what you’ve done and how you present it, including clarity, formatting, grammar, and overall organization.

Need inspiration? This resume template resource offers clean, professional layouts to help you get started: https://word.cloud.microsoft/create/en/resume-templates/

You’re also welcome to use AI tools to help refine your resume, improve clarity, and ensure your experience is represented professionally.

We look forward to learning more about you and the impact you can make at Greenbrook.

Our Selection Process

Application → Initial interview → Operations leadership interview → Clinic visit + short values interview → References

Equal Employment Opportunity and Commitment to Diversity

At Greenbrook Medical, we believe the only way we accomplish our mission is by building the best team in healthcare. We do this through a culture of respect and belonging, ensuring our teammates feel cared for first and foremost.

We will extend equal employment opportunity to all applicants without regard to age, race, ethnicity, sex, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, socioeconomic background, disability status, military affiliation, pregnancy or any other status protected under federal, state and local laws. We encourage all who share our mission to apply. Greenbrook Medical will provide reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process. If you need additional accommodations or assistance, do not hesitate to contact our People team at recruiting@greenbrookmedical.com.

jobs.title: Director, Information Security and GRC
jobs.description:
The Director, Information Security and GRC reports to the Chief Information Officer and leads Lincoln's information security and governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) program. This role sets the security strategy, builds the team and operating model, and serves as the single point of accountability for how Lincoln protects client, tenant, and company data and responds to auditors, clients, and partners.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Set the security and GRC strategy and multi-year roadmap tied to business risk, and review progress with the Chief Information Officer and executive leadership each quarter.

• Report risk posture, open findings, and remediation progress to executive leadership in clear business terms.

• Own a single intake and response process for client and partner security questionnaires and due diligence requests, including named owners, turnaround targets, and a reusable answer library.

• Lead readiness and execution for SOC 1 Type 2 and other SOC reporting, including scoping, control design, evidence collection, testing, auditor management, and remediation.

• Maintain the control framework, policies, standards, and exceptions process, mapped to the frameworks the business is required to meet.

• Coordinate internal and external audits and track findings to closure.

• Manage the enterprise IT risk register and lead a recurring risk review with IT and business owners.

• Build and manage the third-party risk program, including vendor tiering, due diligence, contract security terms, and periodic reassessment.

• Own incident response, including the response plan, tabletop exercises, and the escalation path to executive leadership, Legal, and Communications.

• Oversee vulnerability management, security monitoring, identity and access governance, and email and endpoint protection in partnership with Infrastructure and Cloud and End-User Services.

• Own the data classification policy and data loss prevention standards, and report on adherence.

• Direct managed security providers and security tools, and hold providers to agreed service levels.

• Lead security awareness and phishing training for all employees.

• Provide security guidance on acquisitions and new systems.

• Manage, develop, and mentor the information security and GRC team.

• Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field required; equivalent experience considered in lieu of a degree.

• 10-15 years of progressive experience in information security or GRC, including at least 5 years leading people.

• Demonstrated experience leading SOC 1 or SOC 2 audits from readiness through final report.

• Experience managing high-volume client security due diligence and questionnaire response.

• Working knowledge of NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and cloud security in Azure and Microsoft 365.

• Demonstrated ability to translate risk into business terms for executives, auditors, and clients.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to executive leadership.

• CISSP, CISM, or CRISC certification preferred.

• Commercial real estate, property management, or financial services experience preferred.

• Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Physical Requirements

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

This role involves standard office work with the ability to use a computer for extended periods. This position is based in the Dallas office and works onsite during standard business hours. Minimal travel to regional offices may be required.

#ZIP

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Infrastructure and Cloud
jobs.description:
The Senior Manager, Infrastructure and Cloud reports to the Chief Information Officer and manages Lincoln's network, server, identity, and cloud platforms so they remain available, secure, and recoverable in every office. This role leads the infrastructure team and moves day-to-day operations from outside providers to an internally led model.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Deliver the infrastructure and cloud roadmap and review progress with the Chief Information Officer each quarter.

• Own availability, performance, capacity, patching, monitoring, and backup for network, server, identity, and cloud platforms.

• Lead the transition from managed service providers to internally led operations, including runbooks, service levels, training, and contract wind-down.

• Manage change, incident, and problem management for infrastructure, with clear escalation paths and post-incident reviews.

• Own the Azure-based disaster recovery design and plan, test restores on a set schedule, and report results and gaps to the Chief Information Officer.

• Manage the Azure environment, and AWS if adopted, including landing zones, identity, networking, governance, and cost management.

• Plan and lead infrastructure modernization, including network refresh and consolidation across offices.

• Assume ownership of infrastructure work delivered by outside consultants, set the handoff and exit plan, and build internal skills.

• Manage vendor contracts, service levels, and renewals in partnership with IT Finance.

• Partner with Information Security and GRC on system hardening, vulnerability remediation, access controls, and audit evidence.

• Own single sign-on and multi-factor authentication for business applications, including onboarding new applications to Entra ID.

• Configure and operate Microsoft Purview, data loss prevention, and sensitivity labels in line with policies set by Information Security and GRC.

• Manage the infrastructure budget, including cloud consumption, licensing, and hardware.

• Manage, develop, and mentor the infrastructure team, including Systems Engineers and contract engineers.

• Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field required; equivalent experience considered in lieu of a degree.

• 10-15 years of progressive experience in infrastructure engineering or operations, including at least 5 years leading teams.

• Advanced experience with Azure, Microsoft 365, identity management (Entra ID and Active Directory), and enterprise networking.

• Experience designing and testing disaster recovery for production systems.

• Demonstrated success moving operations from an outsourced model to an in-house team.

• Strong vendor management experience, including contract and service level oversight.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to executives and non-technical leaders.

• Azure architect certification preferred.

• Experience supporting multi-site or distributed office environments preferred.

• Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, End-User Services
jobs.description:
The Senior Manager, End-User Services reports to the Chief Information Officer and leads the technology support experience for all Lincoln employees and partners, including the service desk, devices, onboarding, and meeting room technology. This role replaces outsourced desktop support with a measured, reliable, internally led service built in close partnership with Human Resources.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Deliver fast, courteous support to every employee, partner, and executive, measured by response and resolution targets, ticket quality, backlog, and satisfaction, and report results monthly.

• Own the technology onboarding and offboarding process in partnership with Human Resources and hiring managers so new employees are productive on day one and access is removed on time at exit.

• Set standards for meeting and conference room technology, oversee maintenance, and provide fast response, including for executive and client meetings and events.

• Build an internally led service desk to replace outsourced support, including trained staff, extended weekday phone coverage, a current knowledge base, and an orderly contract wind-down.

• Implement and manage a single IT service management platform that reports volume, trends, and root causes, including migration of tickets and knowledge from the outside provider.

• Manage device standards, provisioning, imaging, patching, and refresh planning for laptops, phones, and peripherals, supported by an accurate asset inventory and lifecycle plan.

• Provide end-user configuration and support for Microsoft 365 in partnership with Infrastructure and Cloud.

• Deliver endpoint protection, access reviews, and audit evidence in partnership with Information Security and GRC.

• Manage the end-user hardware, software, and support budget.

• Manage, develop, and mentor the end-user support team, including service desk and endpoint support staff.

• Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, or related field required; equivalent experience considered in lieu of a degree.

• 8-12 years of progressive experience in end-user support or IT operations, including at least 4 years leading teams.

• Experience managing a service desk against service levels in an IT service management platform.

• Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Windows and Mac device management (Intune or similar), and meeting room technology.

• Demonstrated record of improving customer satisfaction and reducing backlog.

• Experience partnering with Human Resources on onboarding, offboarding, and access processes.

jobs.description:

• Must have excellent communication skills and be able to read, write, speak and understand English.
• Must be able to work inside and outside at all times of the year as needed, based upon business volumes.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Part-Time Keyholder - Houston Galleria
jobs.description:
KEYHOLDER  - PART-TIME

Houston, TX - Houston Galleria

At Rothy’s, we believe there’s a better way to do business—one that puts the planet and its people first. That’s why we’ve transformed millions of plastic bottles into stylish, sustainable shoes and bags, creating wardrobe staples that look just as good as they feel.

In our retail stores, clienteling, and genuine connection are at the heart of everything we do. We take pride in building lasting relationships with our customers—getting to know their style, anticipating their needs, and creating personalized experiences that make them feel truly seen and supported. Whether it’s helping someone find their perfect fit or sharing the story behind our sustainable designs, every interaction is an opportunity to deepen that connection.

As we grow, we’re cultivating not just a workplace, but a community. It’s a place where careers can grow, ideas are shared, and people feel a true sense of belonging. Every day brings new opportunities to learn, lead, and make an impact—together, as part of a welcoming, inclusive team that celebrates each other’s contributions.




ABOUT THE TEAM:

Shopping at Rothy’s IRL is not your ordinary retail experience—so naturally, our Stores team is extraordinary, too. Experts in the fit, wear and sizing of our shoes, these team members provide deep knowledge of every Rothy’s style and out-of-this-world customer service—creating long-lasting brand loyalty. Customers love shopping in our stores due to these exceptional interactions.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Keyholder, you will help bring our company values to life by creating a service-first culture on the sales floor and supporting smooth store operations. You’ll act as a role model for your peers, delivering exceptional customer experiences, coaching in the moment, and upholding operational excellence. As part of the leadership team, you may serve as Manager on Duty, ensuring the store reflects our brand standards and values in every interaction.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Customer Experience (80%)

 - Lead and model Rothy’s Experience through exceptional service and selling on the sales floor by coaching and guiding team members to consistently uphold brand standards

 - Drive personal and team sales results, by delivering the Rothy’s Experience to all customers and supporting your teammates through coaching and team selling

 - Create lasting relationships with our customers by engaging in strong clienteling practices

 - Assist with the execution of in store events and activations that engage the local community, support brand awareness, and drive sales

 - Own assigned areas of responsibility as part of the Division of Responsibility (DOR) program and communicate progress, opportunities, and feedback to store leadership




YOU ARE:

 - Ability to frequently bending, reaching, stretching, and safely use ladders and step stools

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer Intern - Summer 2027
jobs.description:
Who we are

Neros is transforming a defense industry mired in costly, behemoth machinery—to circumvent a looming vulnerability gap, to give dismounted soldiers a fighting chance against tanks, and ultimately, to get as many humans off the battlefield as possible.

While consumer technology is evolving by bounds on the smaller-cheaper-better path, U.S. defense technology wallows in the large, centralized, and wildly expensive paradigm. Our air, land, and sea machinery budget is staggering; yet these large assets can still be vulnerable to very small weapons. When swarm technology comes into its own, the asymmetry will escalate. Nowhere is the pattern more glaring than in small unmanned aerial systems (sUAS)—drones.

What you will be doing

As a Mechanical Engineering Intern at Neros, you'll join a fast-paced, multidisciplinary team designing best-in-class drones and the equipment that supports them. You'll work on one or more of our product lines, contributing to real mechanical design, testing, and manufacturing challenges that make an immediate impact. We're seeking driven engineering students who are ready to put their skills to work, grow new ones, and help advance Neros's mission of credible deterrence at scale.

Responsibilities

• Design hardware to optimize for performance, manufacturability and cost

• Gather requirements and translate these into defensible engineering architectures and decisions

• Perform design trades by effectively leveraging 3D modeling software, FEA tools, prototyping, and engineering first principles

• Create high quality engineering drawings

• Root cause hardware failures and manufacturing issues

• Work with the Manufacturing and Supply Chain teams on build instructions, production tooling/fixtures, and vendor selection

• Plan and execute validation testing for your designs

You should have the following

• Pursuing a BSE or MSE degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field

• Prior experience in fast paced engineering/manufacturing environments, including internships, co-ops, and/or project teams

• Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to solve problems through first principles thinking

• Experience with a CAD software such as Solidworks or NX

Nice to have

• Experience piloting, working with, or designing UAVs (including as a hobby!)

• Experience working in a high volume, cost sensitive industry like consumer electronics or automotive

• Broad knowledge of manufacturing processes and their appropriate applications

• Experience with packaging and integration of PCBAs, batteries, and RF components

• Familiarity with electrical and electromechanical components like BLDC motors and optical sensors

• Experience designing for harsh environments

• Hands-on fabrication skills (general shop tools, manual machining, welding, CNC machining, etc.)

US Salary Range

$55.00/hr USD

We’re an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all applicants without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineering Intern - Summer 2027
jobs.description:
Who we are

Neros is a defense technology company rebuilding America’s drone industrial base. We design and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are tested in combat, iterated at startup speed, and built at massive scale. Our team culture is fast, hands-on, and obsessed with closing the gap between design and deployment.

As drones transform the character of warfare, Neros is delivering the systems the West needs to compete on the modern battlefield and deter the adversaries of democracy. We’re hiring engineers, operators, and builders who want to move fast, take on extreme ownership, and get capability into the hands of warfighters in months, not years.

What you will be doing

As an Electrical Engineer Intern at Neros, you’ll work on hardware that flies. We build low-cost drones for the US military and our allies, and you’ll work on the same boards as the rest of the EE team, from schematic capture and part selection through bring-up, test, and root cause. You’ll also work directly with our AI-Native Electrical Engineer to automate how we design, check, and release boards. This role is for a recent grad or early-career engineer who wants real ownership and a lot of time in the lab.

Responsibilities

• Assist senior engineers in the design of Printed Circuit Boards (PCBs), including schematic capture and component selection

• Support the PCB layout process and participate in the bring-up and functional testing of new hardware

• Build and test prototypes and breadboard circuits to validate design concepts

• Perform hands-on lab work using standard equipment including but not limited to oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, power supplies, logic analyzers and network analyzers

• Execute verification and validation (V&V) test plans, setting up tests and documenting results

• Contribute to root cause analysis investigations under the guidance of senior team members

• Utilize and develop skills in ECAD software (Altium) for schematic and layout tasks

• Work with our AI-Native Electrical Engineer to build tools and agents that automate our design, review, and test workflows

You should have the following

• Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering or a related field

• Experience in a hardware or electrical engineering role (internship experience is a plus)

• Proficiency with standard lab equipment (e.g., oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies)

• Hands-on skills in soldering and wiring for prototypes and rework

• Familiarity with at least one ECAD software package (e.g., Altium, Mentor, KiCad) is highly desirable

• A strong desire to learn, a coachable attitude, and excellent problem-solving skills

Nice to have

• Altium

• Experience with embedded systems, particularly with STM microcontrollers or other ARM Cortex-M based platforms

• Academic or project experience with RF concepts, including wireless protocols like LoRa

• Familiarity with simulation software such as SPICE, or MATLAB

• Experience writing scripts for test automation or data analysis in Python

• Experience building tools with AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor)

• Knowledge of standard communication protocols like SPI, I2C, and UART

• Exposure to circuits for handling analog video (NTSC/PAL) or digital video (MIPI, HDMI)

• Basic C/C++ programming skills for firmware loading and board-level testing

US Salary Range

$55.00/hr USD

We’re an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all applicants without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

jobs.title: Autonomy Intern - Summer 2027
jobs.description:
Who we are

Neros is a defense technology company rebuilding America’s drone industrial base. We design and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are tested in combat, iterated at startup speed, and built at massive scale. Our team culture is fast, hands-on, and obsessed with closing the gap between design and deployment.

As drones transform the character of warfare, Neros is delivering the systems the West needs to compete on the modern battlefield and deter the adversaries of democracy. We’re hiring engineers, operators, and builders who want to move fast, take on extreme ownership, and get capability into the hands of warfighters in months, not years.

What you will be doing

As an Autonomy Software Engineering Intern at Neros, you will be a key hands-on member of our autonomy team, supporting the design, development, and testing of the software that flies our drones. Within our team we tackle a very diverse set of problems from perception, state estimation through guidance and navigation, simulation and the system that measures whether our algorithms work on the actual drone. This role is perfect for a current student or early-career engineer who is eager to learn and grow. By the end of the summer, you will have your own autonomy code running on a real drone, and you will get to watch it fly.

Responsibilities

• Write autonomy software in C++ and Python that runs on the drone

• Implement, test, and tune algorithms against recorded flight data and in closed loop simulation before they go on the real drone

• Help build the tooling that lets us validate new functionality, like evaluation on recorded logs and in simulation

• Take a feature from a design discussion through implementation, code review, simulation, and flight test, and see it fly

• Debug real failures on real data, tracing a bad flight back to the line of code or the bad assumption that caused it

• Work directly with senior engineers across perception, estimation, guidance, and platform to integrate your work into a single autonomy stack that runs on every drone we build

You should have the following

• Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace, or a related field

• Experience in robotics, such as perception, state estimation, localization, tracking, guidance, navigation, planning, or control

• Strong programming ability in C++ and/or Python, and the judgment to write code that other engineers can read, review, and keep running

• Comfort working inside a large existing codebase using Git, and comfort in a Linux development environment

• A strong desire to learn, a coachable attitude, and sharp problem solving instincts

Nice to have

• Hands on experience with robots, drones, autonomous vehicles, or embedded compute

• Coursework or projects in perception, computer vision, tracking, SLAM or VIO, state estimation, control, planning, or machine learning

• Experience with a robotics middleware such as ROS or ROS2

• Familiarity with sensor data: cameras, IMUs, thermal and infrared imagery, calibration, and time synchronization across sensors

• Experience with numerical and data tooling in Python (NumPy, pandas, matplotlib) for analysis and test automation

jobs.title: Spa Coordinator
jobs.description:
JOB OVERVIEW:

Under the guidance of the Spa Supervisor, the Spa Coordinator is responsible for supporting the daily operations of the spa by managing appointment scheduling, guest services, and administrative tasks. This role ensures smooth communication between guests, members and spa staff, helps maintain a welcoming environment, and contributes to delivering an exceptional guest experience.

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Manage daily appointment bookings and schedule spa services efficiently in Book4Time
• Greet and welcome guests, ensuring a warm and professional first impression
• Handle guest inquiries, requests, and resolve any service issues promptly
• Maintain accurate records of guest information and service history in the booking system
• Coordinate communication between spa therapists, management, and guests
• Assist with billing and processing payments accurately
• Support inventory management by tracking retail and spa supplies
• Maintain cleanliness and organization of the reception, retail and waiting areas
• Promote spa services, packages, and retail products to guests
• Ensure adherence to spa policies, including cancellation and no-show procedures
• Assist with administrative tasks such as reporting, email correspondence, and updating schedules
• Collaborate with the spa team to support smooth daily operations and exceptional guest experience
• We recognize we are in the hospitality industry and that may require us to provide lateral service. We will on occasion call for each individual in the team to on a routine basis perform various related tasks as needed in the spirit of providing exceptional guest service.

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, to provide clear direction to the venue teams.
• Communicate with team members using a positive and clear speaking voice, listen to and understand requests, respond with appropriate actions and provide accurate information.
• Remain calm and alert, especially during emergency situations.
• Make decisions and take actions based on previous experience and good judgment, sometimes revising procedures to accommodate unusual situations.

SPECIFIC JOB KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

• High school Diploma or equivalent education required. Bachelor’s Degree preferred
• Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in a spa, wellness, or hospitality environment
• Working knowledge of spa operations, treatment protocols, and guest service standards
• Proficient in spa booking and management systems (Book4Time)
• Strong customer service orientation with a warm, welcoming, and professional demeanor
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills
• Ability to manage a high volume of bookings and guest interactions with efficiency
• Solid understanding of retail sales techniques and product knowledge
• Ability to anticipate guest needs and personalize service accordingly
• Strong multitasking and time management skills in a fast-paced environment
• Detail-oriented with accurate handling of guest records, payments, and service notes
• Capable of resolving guest concerns or complaints diplomatically and effectively
• Familiarity with front desk operations, including answering phones, email correspondence, and POS systems

The Senior Vice President of Medical Affairs will provide executive leadership for all medical affairs activities across Rezolute's portfolio and pipeline.
