jobs.title: Social Media Strategist
jobs.description:
ABOUT EXA

AI agents need to find information on the web. Exa is building the search engine they use to do it.

We built our own web index and retrieval models from scratch. Today, Exa powers products at companies including Cursor, Cognition, and HubSpot. In 2026, we crossed $100 million in annualized revenue and 2 billion searches per month.

We raised a $250 million Series C led by a16z, with participation from Benchmark, Lightspeed, and Y Combinator. Our team of researchers, engineers, builders, and former founders is primarily based in San Francisco.

We are looking for a social media strategist to shape Exa’s voice, create original content, and bring our work to the developers and technology leaders building with AI.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Exa built a search engine from scratch for AI. You will show the world what people can build with it and introduce them to the people behind it.

You will own Exa’s organic social presence and make it worth following. You will spend time with the people building the product, find the ideas that deserve an audience, and turn them into posts, videos, and series that people actually want to share.

This is a role for someone who can set the strategy and create content themselves. One day you might interview an engineer about a search breakthrough. The next, you might help a founder turn an idea into a post or show what an AI agent can do with Exa.

You will report to the head of communications and work closely with product marketing and our creative team.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Social strategy. Build the plan for Exa’s company channels, starting with X and LinkedIn. Give each a purpose and a point of view. Decide where else we should show up and what is worth the investment.

 - Original content. Find the stories inside Exa and bring them to life through posts, short videos, interviews, and visual content. Create recurring formats that make people want to come back. Make technical ideas accessible without losing what makes them interesting.

 - Executive presence. Work with our founders and leaders to turn their ideas into posts that sound like them. Bring them opportunities to contribute to conversations about AI, search, and building a company.

 - Launches and company moments. Own the social plan for product releases, research, customer stories, and events. Show what a new capability makes possible. Coordinate timing, assets, and reviews across company and executive channels.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - More developers and technology leaders know Exa and follow our work.

 - Our channels show what Exa can do and give people a reason to come back.

 - Launch posts put new capabilities in action and bring interested people to the product.

 - Our founders and leaders share ideas that sound like them and add something to the conversation.

 - Our recurring formats build an audience, and we know what to improve or stop.

 - We move quickly from idea to publication without compromising accuracy or quality.




WHO YOU ARE

 - You have at least five years of experience in social media, editorial, or content creation, including work you made yourself.

 - You can show how your strategy and creative decisions helped grow an audience.

 - You write clearly, edit rigorously, and know how to make a technical subject interesting.

 - You can film and edit short videos and create simple visual assets independently.

 - You know what works on different platforms and create for each one.

 - You are curious about AI, search, and developer tools, and can make them fun and accessible to different audiences.

 - You enjoy working with founders and engineers, can manage competing deadlines, and follow through on details.

 - You use AI tools thoughtfully and know when a story needs original reporting and human judgment.




LOGISTICS/BENEFITS

 - This is an in-person role in SF.

 - Health and wellness: Premium medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus a monthly wellness benefit, and a monthly commuter benefit.

 - Fertility and family planning: Reimbursement for eligible egg freezing and related medical expenses up to a $15,000 lifetime maximum, plus 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, whether through birth, adoption, surrogacy, or foster placement.

 - Life at Exa: Lunch and dinner served daily, an office stocked with snacks, coffee, and health supplements

 - Visa sponsorship: We sponsor visas for exceptional candidates and welcome applicants from all backgrounds and locations.

Exa is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related conditions, criminal histories consistent with applicable law, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Sr. Sourcing Specialist (Network Infrastructure)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. SOURCING SPECIALIST (NETWORK INFRASTRUCTURE)

We are a progressive procurement organization pushing the boundaries of traditional procurement reputation and methodologies. We are looking for individuals who can think outside the box to achieve company objectives regarding value and partnerships with our suppliers. Our organization moves quickly, and you must too. SpaceX has the unique ability and desire to influence and shape suppliers to be better with us as we challenge our supply chain on cost, quality, and delivery.

In this role you will own end-to-end sourcing strategy, supplier management, and delivery for one or more categories of datacenter network infrastructure: switches and NICs/DPUs, optical transceivers and their components, copper and active electrical cables, and fiber and structured cabling. Network hardware is among the highest-volume and most supply-constrained categories in AI infrastructure. You will partner with network engineering on roadmaps, secure capacity at every tier of the supply chain, and execute at the speed SpaceXAI builds. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in at least one network hardware category, thrives in high-ambiguity, high-velocity environments, and has a proven track record of securing supply in constrained markets.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Own end-to-end sourcing for assigned network categories, which may include switches, NICs/DPUs, optical transceivers and components, AEC/DAC copper cables, and fiber assemblies and structured cabling

• Partner with network engineering and architecture teams on roadmaps and approved vendor lists, including higher-speed optics, co-packaged optics, and next-generation switch silicon

• Own supplier selection, qualification, dual/multi-sourcing, capacity reservation, and performance governance to achieve on-time delivery and continuous lead-time compression

• Build visibility into tier-2 supply (lasers, DSPs, substrates, and other constrained components) and secure capacity through capacity reservations, directed-buy, or tri-party agreements

• Turn cluster network and cabling plans into orders, with kitting and labeling that land material at site ready to install; track supply, demand, and open orders by cluster and site

• Monitor supply chain risks and implement mitigation plans for critical network components, including second sources for single-source categories

• Create, negotiate, and administer supply agreements, SOWs, and purchase orders in collaboration with the legal department; manage contracts to ensure supplier performance to contract obligations

• Conduct market research, benchmarking, should-cost modeling, and advanced quantitative analyses to identify the financial impact of decisions and set targets for cost savings, payment terms, and cash

• Collaborate with stakeholders to define SLAs and KPIs for suppliers (cost, quality, delivery, and resilience); run performance scorecards and business reviews, and drive corrective action

• Identify and execute cost reduction projects, including planning, coordinating with stakeholders, estimating completion, and reporting progress

• Present value propositions to SpaceX management, including contract awards, cost reviews, cost reduction strategies, and critical supply issues

• Place purchase orders, resolve blocked invoices, and streamline the PO-to-pay process to reduce transactions and cycle time for assigned categories

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Advanced degree; or bachelor’s degree and 2+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; or 6+ years of experience working in one or more of the following: Engineering Supply chain Purchasing Contract negotiation Material or production planning Operations management Material cost control Master production scheduling

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Technical understanding of one or more network hardware categories: Ethernet and InfiniBand switching, NICs/DPUs, optics, AEC/DAC, or fiber connectivity

• Previous experience at hyperscalers, network OEMs, optical module or component makers, cable and fiber manufacturers, distributors, or AI infrastructure companies

• Experience with tier-2 supply chains, directed-buy agreements, or high-volume PO execution in an ERP environment

• Strong negotiation, analytical, project management, and cross-functional collaboration skills

• Strong contract management, budget tracking, cost analysis, and financial modeling skills

• Effective written, verbal, and presentation communication skills

• Remarkable problem-solving skills with a bias for speed

• Strong technical knowledge of current tools and applications (e.g., MS Office Suite, SQL, Power BI)

• Ability to conduct all activities with the highest degree of integrity

• Detail-oriented, self-motivated, and able to respond quickly to a fast-moving and ever-changing environment

• Passion for SpaceX's mission and excitement about enabling the fastest AI infrastructure builds on Earth

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be able to travel - up to 50% work week travel may be required, including international travel to supplier factories, audits, and critical projects

• Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to meet major cluster-deployment milestones

• Ability to thrive in a dynamic environment with rapidly evolving priorities and world-class execution speed

• This position is based in Austin, TX and requires being onsite - remote work not considered

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

GNC ENGINEER (STARSHIP)

As a GNC Engineer, you will be responsible for pushing the technical boundaries of flight control systems for the world’s most advanced rockets, including our next-generation Starship vehicle, a fully reusable spacecraft capable of carrying humans to the Moon, Mars and beyond. • Excellent communication skills both written and verbal

jobs.description:

SUPPLIER QUALITY SPECIALIST (SPACEXSI)

SpaceX is seeking a Supplier Quality Specialist for the Superintelligence program. You will inspect, document, and disposition process gas, power plant consumables, electrical spares, and cooling spares before they are released to operations. You will catch nonconforming material at the supplier or at the dock, and you will drive the supplier to a real corrective action.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Execute supplier quality for assigned process gas, power plant consumables, electrical spares, and cooling spares

• Perform receiving inspection against the purchase order, specification, and inspection plan, and record objective results

• Review certificates of conformance, material test reports, gas analyses, and supplier test data before release

• Conduct source inspection and witness tests at suppliers when assigned, including dimensional, visual, and documentation checks

• Quarantine nonconforming material, write the nonconformance, and contain product already in the warehouse or issued to the plant

• Issue supplier corrective actions and follow them until the root cause and the corrective action are verified

• Support supplier audits and process assessments led by the Lead Supplier Quality Specialist

• Give planning and the warehouse a clear hold or release status so maintenance does not pick a rejected part

• Identify repeat defects on consumables, electrical components, and cooling parts and raise them for supplier action

• Keep inspection records complete enough that another specialist can see why the material was accepted or rejected

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree or 3+ years of experience in an engineering, supply chain, manufacturing or quality field

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• 5+ years of quality experience with industrial equipment, power generation, electrical products, or process plants

• Experience inspecting electrical components, rotating or stationary mechanical spares, valves, pumps, or heat exchangers

• Experience reviewing gas certificates of analysis or chemical and lubricant certifications

• Familiarity with ISO 9001, material traceability, and first-article or source inspection

• Experience with hand tools and standard inspection instruments, and with knowing when a part needs a lab or a higher-level test

• Experience in a quality or ERP system for inspection results and nonconformances

• Clear written records and direct communication with suppliers, buyers, and warehouse staff

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be able to work onsite

• Must be available for extended hours and weekends when receipts or source inspections are on the critical path

• up to 25% travel to supplier facilities for source inspection

• Ability to work in a warehouse and industrial environment and wear required personal protective equipment

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About DEUNA 🧡
 
DEUNA is a rapidly growing startup revolutionizing global commerce with ATHIA, our AI-powered orchestration and payments platform that helps large enterprises boost approval rates, reduce costs, and unlock new revenue. Built by the team behind DEUNA—the fastest-growing Commerce OS in Latin America—ATHIA combines payment intelligence, checkout optimization, and data orchestration in one powerful solution.
 
With deep integrations across 300+ PSPs and alternative payment methods, and over 20% of Mexico’s digital economy running through our platform, we simplify global payments through a single integration and centralized reconciliation.
We are a rapidly growing startup expanding into the U.S. to meet the urgent needs of large retailers, marketplaces, airlines, and QSRs. Join us to shape the future of payments! 🚀
 
Visit https://www.deuna.com/ to learn more about us!


About the Role
We are looking for a Field Marketing Manager based in Brazil to build the pipeline engine that powers DEUNA's regional sales team. You will work hand in hand with Sales, SDRs, and Partnerships to generate and qualify leads, run events, and build DEUNA's brand and press presence across Brazil and Latin America. This role requires full professional fluency in Portuguese, Spanish, and English, as you will create and adapt content and work daily with teams in all three languages.
Key Responsibilities
Lead Generation with SDRs and Partnerships
Design and run demand-generation campaigns (outbound, ABM, paid, email, LinkedIn, content) that deliver qualified pipeline for Sales.
Work with the SDR team on target account lists, messaging, sequences, and lead handoff criteria; review conversion rates at each stage and optimize.
Partner with the Partnerships team on co-marketing with PSPs, acquirers, e-commerce platforms, and agencies: joint campaigns, webinars, case studies, and referral programs.
Own lead quality and attribution in the CRM (HubSpot), and report on funnel metrics from lead to opportunity to closed-won.
Event Organization
Plan, budget, and execute DEUNA's presence at industry events, conferences, and trade shows in Brazil and LATAM, plus our own executive roundtables, webinars, and customer dinners.
Define the event strategy: which events to attend, goals, target account invitations, pre-event outreach, on-site execution, and post-event follow-up with Sales.
Manage vendors, sponsorships, speaking opportunities, and logistics; measure ROI per event.
PR & Communications
Build and execute the PR strategy for Brazil and the region: press releases, media relations, executive thought leadership, awards, and analyst/industry visibility.
Manage relationships with fintech, e-commerce, and business media and PR agencies.
Coordinate announcements (partnerships, product launches, funding, customer wins) with global and regional teams.
Content & Localization
Adapt and create content in Portuguese, Spanish, and English: website, case studies, decks, one-pagers, social, and sales enablement materials.
Ensure consistent brand voice and messaging across languages and markets.
Requirements
5+ years of B2B marketing experience in fintech, payments, e-commerce, SaaS, or technology.
Proven experience generating pipeline through demand generation, working closely with Sales and SDR teams.
Hands-on experience organizing events and managing sponsorships.
Experience with PR and media relations.
Full fluency in Portuguese, Spanish, and English (written and spoken).
Strong project management, analytical, and communication skills.
Experience with HubSpot or similar CRM/marketing automation tools.
Availability to travel within Brazil and Latin America.
Preferred Qualifications
Knowledge of the Brazilian payments and e-commerce ecosystem (PIX, installments, local acquirers, marketplaces).
Experience in partner or channel marketing.
Existing network in the Brazilian fintech and e-commerce community.
Success Metrics
Marketing-sourced and SDR-sourced qualified pipeline in Brazil.
Pipeline generated from co-marketing with partners.
Events delivered on budget, with measured pipeline and ROI.
Earned media coverage and share of voice in target outlets.
Lead-to-opportunity conversion rate.

jobs.title: Catering Assistant
jobs.description:
JOB OVERVIEW

The Catering & QSR Associate supports daily catering operations and Quick Service Restaurant (QSR) service to ensure an exceptional guest experience and smooth execution across both departments. This role assists with preparing, organizing, and fulfilling catering orders, including high-volume orders during the holiday season, while providing hands-on support to QSR counters as business needs change.

The Catering & QSR Associate works closely with the Catering team, QSR leadership, and other store departments to coordinate orders, prepare food and beverages, maintain product quality, and deliver friendly, efficient service. Responsibilities may shift between catering and QSR depending on business volume, staffing needs, and seasonal demand.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Catering Support

• Assist with the preparation, organization, packaging, and fulfillment of daily catering orders, ensuring accuracy and timely completion.
• Support high-volume catering orders and seasonal business demands, including holiday catering operations.
• Coordinate catering order details with internal departments to ensure products are prepared and available according to customer requirements.
• Communicate with the Catering team, store departments, and other relevant partners regarding order status, special requests, and fulfillment needs.
• Assist with customer inquiries, order follow-ups, and providing information about catering offerings.
• Help prepare catering materials, labels, and order documentation to ensure accurate fulfillment.
• Support the preparation and organization of catering pickups and deliveries as assigned.
• Maintain organized catering work areas and ensure orders are properly stored, labeled, and ready for fulfillment.
• Provide friendly, professional service to catering customers and help resolve routine order questions or concerns by partnering with the appropriate team members.

Quick Service Restaurant (QSR) Support

• Provide service across Eataly’s various QSR counters, including coffee, gelato, pastries, paninis, and other Italian food and beverage offerings.
• Prepare and serve food and beverages according to established recipes, quality standards, and service procedures.
• Operate espresso machines, drink blenders, juicers, cash registers, and other equipment as needed.
• Complete food preparation assignments neatly, accurately, and in a timely manner.
• Set up service stations, replenish product displays, and maintain appropriate product presentation, including proper separation of allergens.
• Weigh, label, package, and serve products according to department standards.
• Process guest transactions accurately and follow established cash-handling procedures.
• Maintain product freshness and proper rotation by following First In, First Out (FIFO) practices and ensuring items are appropriately dated.
• Assist with receiving, organizing, and replenishing products and supplies as needed.
• Maintain clean, organized, and well-stocked workstations throughout the shift.
• Provide exceptional guest service by answering questions, communicating product information, and supporting an efficient service experience.

Cross-Department Operations & Standards

• Transition between catering and QSR responsibilities based on business volume, seasonal demand, and direction from department leadership.
• Collaborate with the Catering and QSR teams to support daily operational priorities and ensure continuity of service.
• Follow Eataly’s food quality, food safety, health, sanitation, and workplace safety standards.
• Maintain accurate order information and communicate any discrepancies, delays, or operational concerns to the appropriate team members.
• Follow established procedures for food handling, storage, labeling, cleaning, and equipment use.
• Maintain a professional, guest-focused approach when interacting with customers, coworkers, and other departments.
• Perform other duties as required or assigned.

• Previous experience in food service, hospitality, catering, retail, or customer service preferred.
• Experience preparing or fulfilling catering orders is a plus.
• Experience operating a cash register or preparing coffee and other beverages is preferred.
• Strong communication and customer service skills.
• Ability to stay organized, manage multiple tasks, and maintain attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.
• Ability to work collaboratively across departments and adapt to changing business needs.
• Commitment to food quality, cleanliness, safety, and exceptional guest service.
• Basic computer skills for reviewing order information and completing assigned administrative tasks.
• High school diploma or equivalent preferred.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

• Availability to work onsite with a flexible schedule, often including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
• Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
• Ability to exert well-paced mobility for up to 8 hours, including standing, walking, bending, and squatting.
• Ability to operate equipment such as manual espresso machines, drink blenders, juicers, and cash registers.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced food service environment and shift between catering and QSR duties as operational needs require.

Benefits and Perks

• Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance
• Paid Time Off
• Paid Parental Leave
• 401K with match
• Free family meal daily
• Discounts at Eataly
• Referral bonus program
• and more!

Compensation: Pay rate is set at $20 - $23 an hour. (Not a commission base position)

It is the Company’s policy to not unlawfully discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability or any other characteristic made unlawful to consider by applicable federal, state, or local laws. Eataly also prohibits harassment of applicants and employees based on any of these protected categories. It is also Eataly’s policy to comply with all applicable federal, state and local laws regarding consideration of unemployment status, salary history, credit/bankruptcy history and criminal background/conviction history in making hiring decisions.  If contacted for an employment opportunity, please advise Human Resources if you require accommodation.

jobs.title: Part Time Floor Leader - Southport Avenue
jobs.description:
Position: Part Time Floor Leader

Weekly: 20-29 hours

Interview Plan

Floor Leader

As a Floor Leader, you'll play a vital role in supporting the Store Management Team across all areas of the business. This includes everything from driving sales and opening/closing the store to analyzing sales results and leading training sessions. Together with your fellow leaders, you'll work to ensure that every aspect of the store is firing on all cylinders, creating an exceptional customer experience, a happy and motivated staff, and operational excellence that would make even the most detail-oriented among us proud.

Your day-to-day will be spent on the shop floor, where you'll lead and inspire a team of sales associates to achieve and surpass their goals. By fostering a culture of passion and positivity, you'll help create a work environment that's both productive and fun, resulting in happy customers and happy employees. The Floor Leader role is all about making the world a better place one soap at a time!

Responsibilities:

Sales & Customer Experience:

• Driving Sales: Utilize the StoreForce dashboard results to provide effective coaching and feedback to the sales team, and make necessary adjustments to the shop floor structure to meet and exceed sales goals. Take ownership for your results and actively work to grow the contribution of your segments to the store’s overall sales. Celebrate sales achievements with your team!

• Customer Experience: Lead by example in delivering a world-class customer experience on the shop floor, including product demonstrations. Observe and listen to consultations, collaborate with your team, and strive to exceed daily sales goals. By fostering a culture of excellence in customer service, you'll drive sales, create a loyal customer base, and build a positive reputation for your store.

• Building the Brand: Educate customers on Lush brand values, and articulate our position on Fighting Animal Testing, Freshest Cosmetics, Ethical Buying, 100% Vegetarian, Handmade, and Naked Packaging in the shop and through community engagement, hosting store parties, and other traffic-driving initiatives.

• Product Passion: increase the depth of your product knowledge through constant learning and consistently make informed product recommendations for every need.

Team Involvement:

• Development: Train and coach Sales Ambassadors and peers on effective sales techniques and product knowledge to improve their performance, support the growth of your team, and to increase sales. Lead by example, take ownership of your development, assess your performance, and actively seek feedback, resources, and opportunities to improve and elevate your skills, knowledge and abilities.

• Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging: Encourage open communication and actively listen to team members perspectives related to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB). Foster a sense of belonging by promoting teamwork, encouraging collaboration, and recognizing and valuing each employee's unique contributions.

Operational Excellence:

• Cash Handling and Store Opening/Closing: Manage cash handling, including customer transactions, opening/closing the register, reconciling cash drawers, preparing nightly deposits, and securing the store at the end of each day. As required at your store location, take deposits to the bank.

• Time and Attendance: Lead by example in terms of attendance and punctuality, and encourage the same from all employees. Monitor employee breaks to ensure they are taking their scheduled breaks, promoting a healthy work environment and improving employee wellbeing. Review daily communications, including store updates and task lists, to ensure that team members are informed and prepared for their shifts, promoting a culture of preparedness and organization.

• Visuals and Merchandising: Maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing store to enhance the customer's shopping experience and drive sales.

• Stock and Inventory: Train your team on inventory best practices and fresh standards, and support management with inventory tasks. Utilize Visual Merchandising guidelines to make real-time adjustments to product displays based on sales and improve the customer experience.

• Policies and Procedures: Support your management team to keep your store compliant and ensure your staff are practicing company standards for opening and closing, product integrity, respectful workplace, and health and safety.

Qualifications:

Required:

• Minimum 1 year of experience in:

• customer service and sales

• cash handling and opening/closing procedures

• supervisory experience involving coaching, feedback, and training

• problem-solving issues related to customer service in day-to-day operations

• a fast-paced team environment

• Knowledge and passion for skincare, natural beauty, and ethical business

• Flexible schedule to accommodate store needs, including evenings, weekends, and holidays

Preferred:

• Experience with consultation-based customer service models

• Experience analyzing sales metrics

• Experience working in skincare or cosmetics

• Experience in cross cultural collaboration and DEIB or social justice training

• Fluency in Spanish, French or other languages

Southport Pay

$19.80—$19.80 USD

Best of luck on your job search, and don't forget to follow us to learn more!

We Are Lush

YouTube
LinkedIn

Lush Cosmetics North America respectfully recognizes that our business operates on Indigenous territory across Turtle Island. As a business headquartered in Canada, our largest facilities are located on the unceded territories of the Musqueam, Squamish and Tsleil-Waututh, as well as here on the lands of the Mississaugas of the Credit, Anishnabeg, Chippewa, Haudenosaunee and Wendat, and now home to many diverse First Nations, Inuit and Métis peoples.

Our commitment to reconciliation and decolonization is guided by the Truth and Reconciliation Commission of Canada: Calls to Action #92. We recognize that our facilities, along with our settler and newcomer staff are guests on this land and as we act to repair past harm, we do it together in allyship with Indigenous People everywhere, including staff, customers and with leadership from organizations and communities we work with.

jobs.title: SPMT Operator - Transport (Starship)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SPMT OPERATOR - TRANSPORT (STARSHIP)

The SPMT Operator – Transport is responsible for moving Booster, Ship, and associated ground support equipment across Starbase and between launch sites. Technicians in this role operate self-propelled modular transporters (SPMTs) and commercial motor vehicles, and they set up, inspect, and maintain the transport equipment that carries flight hardware from load securement through route, escort, and set-down.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Move Booster, Ship, and associated ground support equipment (GSE) across Starbase and between launch sites

• Operate self-propelled modular transporters (SPMTs) and hydraulic platform or modular trailers to roll flight hardware and GSE on site

• Drive commercial motor vehicles to haul flight hardware, GSE, and support equipment on public roads and across the site

• Set up, inspect, operate, and maintain hydraulic SPMTs, power packs, trailers, and the transport configuration called out for the move

• Build up and tear down SPMT and trailer configurations, including axle lines, goosenecks, and load decks

• Perform preventative maintenance on SPMTs, transport trailers, tractors, and assigned transport equipment

• Carry out the transport plan: load placement, center of gravity, tie-down and securement, axle and ground loading, route clearance, speed, and weather limits

• Evaluate in-transit risk and put a fix in place on site, including routing, repairs, permits, escorts, and drivers, and walk physical escorts across launch sites

• Hand the load off to the crane and rigging crew at pick-up and set-down so the move stays on plan

• Recommend changes to transport leadership that improve the safety, timing, and condition of every move

• Work with technicians and engineers so transport equipment is kept at the quality needed for the current and future manifest

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate

• 1+ years of experience on a critical lift team or a logistics/transport team

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• 2+ years operating SPMTs and/or hydraulic platform trailers on oversized or sensitive loads

• Class A CDL with oversize or overweight permit loads, including escort and route coordination

• Both a current CDL and hands-on SPMT operating experience

• Ability to read a transport plan, engineering drawing, or work instruction and confirm that load placement, securement, route, and loading and unloading match the plan

• Experience maintaining and troubleshooting hydraulic and mechanical systems on SPMTs, trailers, or heavy-haul equipment

• Familiarity with calibrated measurement devices, including load cells, calipers, torque wrenches, depth gauges, and micrometers

• Organized, able to run more than one move at a time, and precise against a deadline

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Able to secure, block, and tie down a load and walk the move against the transport plan

• Must be available to work extended hours and weekends, which varies depending on site operational needs; flexibility required (day shift: 6 AM - 6 PM and night shift: 6 PM - 6 AM)

• Ability to pass Airforce background check for Cape Canaveral and Vandenberg

• Flexibility to travel 25-50% of the time

• Valid driver's license

• Stand: Up to 10 hours per day

• Sit: Up to 6 hours per day

• Push/Pull: Up to 75lbs. (unassisted) 1-2 hours per day

• Overhead reach: Up to 6 hours per day

• Walk: Up to 10 hours per day

• Lift/Carry: Up to 50lbs. (unassisted) 1-2 hours per day

• Climb (ladder/stairs): Up to 6 hours per day

• Kneel/Crouch: Up to 6 hours per day

• Upper body twist: Up to 6 hours per day

• Ability to work in temperatures over 80 degrees: up to 3 hours per day

• Candidate must be capable of safely working at heights (up to 500ft), in confined spaces, using an air purifying respirator, and performing the physical requirements of the job listed in the job description. Candidate may be required to complete a pre-employment questionnaire and/or physical to confirm these capabilities, which may include a medical history review

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

CRITICAL LIFT & TRANSPORT ENGINEER (STARSHIP)

SpaceX is currently seeking an individual to join the launch site engineering team in Starbase, TX. As a member of this team, you will have the opportunity to utilize your multi-disciplinary knowledge, experience, and creativity to develop solutions to launch pad operations, ground support equipment, transportation, and production with the goal of maximizing efficiency without sacrificing safety or reliability.

Specifically, you will be responsible for ensuring all aspects of critical transport and lift operations for our Starship and Super Heavy booster vehicles, as well as ground support equipment, have been properly designed, reviewed, and carried out. You will be responsible for addressing complex structural, civil, and mechanical issues that arise and utilizing engineering intuition as well as thorough calculation to provide engineering disposition for the path forward.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Plan, analyze, and execute critical lifts and heavy-haul transports for large-scale hardware (e.g., rocket stages, ground support equipment, or structural components), ensuring compliance with safety standards, regulations (e.g., OSHA, ASME B30), and engineering best practices.

• Develop critical lift plans, rigging designs, and transport configurations using tools like AutoCAD, finite element analysis (FEA), and center-of-gravity calculations.

• Coordinate with cross-functional teams (e.g., vehicle structures, manufacturing, launch ops, logistics) to assess hardware mass properties, rigging/lashing connection locations, structural capability, stability, and load paths during lifts and transports.

• Select and specify equipment such as mobile/crawler cranes, self-propelled modular transporters (SPMTs), conventional hydraulic trailers, and rigging hardware; perform equipment inspections and capacity verifications.

• Conduct risk assessments, hazard analyses, and fatigue/stress analyses for lifts exceeding standard capacities.

• Oversee on-site operations, including pre-lift dry runs, real-time monitoring, and post-operation debriefs.

• Interface with external vendors for specialized equipment rentals and oversee contracted operations involving cranes, rigging, hydraulic trailers, and marine transport.

• Maintain documentation, including engineering calculations, drawings, and reports for regulatory audits and lessons learned.

• Support off-hour operations as needed, including real-time troubleshooting and issue resolution during high-stakes/first-time lifts or transports.

• Drive continuous improvement and development in lift/transport processes, such as adopting new technologies.

• Represent SpaceX by presenting certification packages and engineering data to US government agencies, including NASA, US Space Force, and others.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline.

• 2+ years of hands-on experience working with mechanical and structural hardware.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• 1+ years of experience with crane lifting, rigging, or transport operations.

• Experience prioritizing and executing tasks in high-pressure, fast-paced industrial environments while operating with or around hazardous systems (high pressure, high energy, hazardous gases & fluids, etc.).

• Experience using SOLIDWORKS, Siemens NX, or similar CAD software.

• Proficiency in engineering analysis software (e.g. ANSYS, FEMAP or similar finite element analysis software) for static/dynamic load modeling.

• Strong understanding of mechanics, including statics, dynamics, materials science, and failure modes.

• Familiarity with relevant lifting standards and regulations.

• Expertise in specialized equipment like crawler cranes, all-terrain cranes, SPMTs, jacks, and gantries.

• Experience reviewing data from anomalies and identifying root cause.

• Professional certifications such as crane operator + rigger (NCCCO + NCCER) or Professional Engineer (PE) license.

• Ability to prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure, fast paced environment.

• Knowledge of SpaceX-specific or similar hardware (e.g., Falcon/Starship transport logistics).

• Strong communication skills for presenting complex plans to leadership and training junior staff.

• Master's degree in a relevant engineering discipline or related advanced training.

• Strong work ethic and drive to for constant improvement balanced with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be willing to work weekends and night shifts as needed.

• Must be willing to travel to other launch sites in support of operational activities and launches; travel requirement is up to 25%.

jobs.title: 2027 Ogilvy Creative Summer Internship
jobs.description:
About Ogilvy

Ogilvy has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture-changing, value-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy more than 75 years ago. It builds on that rich legacy through Borderless Creativity—innovating at the intersection of intelligence, imagination and influence, with experts across advertising, sports & entertainment, PR & social, consulting, and health collaborating seamlessly across more than 120 offices spanning 90 countries. Ogilvy was named Network of the Year at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity and ranks as the #1 global agency network for creative excellence and effectiveness by WARC for the fourth consecutive year, signifying its ability to deliver creative solutions that drive unreasonable impact for clients and communities. Ogilvy is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. For more information, visit Ogilvy.com, and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and Facebook.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

Ogilvy is looking for the next generation of creative talent. The insatiably curious, the dot-connectors, the ones who love to "make it happen." Your passion for creation has gotten you this far; now see if it can earn you a spot at Ogilvy.

Please note: The application deadline is January 19, 2027, at 11:59 p.m. ET.

The Summer Internship Program:

Ready to gain hands-on experience working with live client briefs and contribute to work that makes a cultural impact? Our Summer Internship is the place for you. For 10 weeks, from June to August, interns jump right into the action, contributing to current campaigns and fast-moving projects alongside our award-winning creative teams. Interns gain wide exposure to different brands and creative leaders, with dedicated mentorship to sharpen their craft and gain the real-world experience that makes a portfolio shine.

The Roles & What We're Looking For:

We’re not just interested in what you’ve done, but how you think. To be considered for a creative role, your application must include a link to a portfolio or sample of work - show us your creative process and unique point of view.

We are looking for interns in the following creative roles within The Ogilvy Group, including Ogilvy, Ogilvy Health and Grey:

• Art Director: You think BIG, translating ideas simply for impactful solutions across various platforms. You're a team player with a strong visual sensibility and craft.

• Copywriter: You write and read a lot, understanding big conceptual ideas and the nuance of execution across diverse categories.

• Designer: You 'geek out' on design principles, techniques, and trends, applying a logical, analytical, and empathetic approach to solve human problems.

Please note: This application is specifically for creative craft internships. A separate application exists for other general business and strategy roles and can be found on our careers page.

The Fine Print:

• Locations: The 2027 Summer Internship Program will be offered in our Chicago and New York offices.

• Hybrid Model: This is a full-time (35-40 hours a week) paid internship that operates in a hybrid model, with 3-4 days expected to be in office. To ensure you can fully immerse yourself in our collaborative culture, come the start of the program in June, you must be located within a commutable distance of the office you plan to work in.

• Eligibility: All applicants must be 18 years or older, have current and future U.S. work authorization, and submit a link to a portfolio or sample of work

The base salary range for this position at the time of this posting is indicated below. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package, click here for more details.

Pay Range

$20—$25 USD

We believe in building powerful teams with purpose - and we relentlessly curate transformative initiatives that make our commitment to fairness, and equity a reality.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Supply Chain (Network Infrastructure)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. MANAGER, SUPPLY CHAIN (NETWORK INFRASTRUCTURE)

We are a progressive procurement organization pushing the boundaries of traditional procurement reputation and methodologies. We are looking for individuals who can think outside the box to achieve company objectives regarding value and partnerships with our suppliers. Our organization moves quickly, and you must too. SpaceX has the unique ability and desire to influence and shape suppliers to be better with us as we challenge our supply chain on cost, quality, and delivery.

We are seeking a leader to build and manage a team responsible for sourcing and supply chain strategy for datacenter network infrastructure: switches and NICs/DPUs, optical transceivers and components, copper and active electrical cables, and fiber connectivity for SpaceXAI's large-scale AI training clusters. You will define commodity strategies, build team capabilities, align roadmaps with network engineering and vendors, secure supply across every tier of the supply chain, and optimize for cost, quality, speed, and resilience. The ideal candidate is an experienced people leader with deep expertise in network hardware sourcing and a track record of delivering results in hyperscale AI infrastructure.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing sourcing team across switches and NICs/DPUs, optics, copper and active electrical cables, and fiber and structured cabling

• Define commodity strategies, multi-year roadmaps, and approved vendor lists with network engineering and architecture teams, including transitions to higher-speed optics, co-packaged optics, and next-generation switch silicon

• Oversee end-to-end sourcing, supplier qualification, multi-sourcing, and performance management to meet aggressive build schedules

• Orchestrate demand across clusters and sites, and align internal roadmaps with key vendors to secure preferential allocation and capacity

• Build visibility into tier-2 supply (lasers, DSPs, substrates, and other constrained components) and secure capacity ahead of demand through capacity reservations and directed-buy agreements

• Manage the integration and distribution partners that kit, integrate, and deliver network hardware and cabling to site

• Negotiate major agreements focused on pricing, volume, technology access, and reliable delivery, using creative approaches as needed

• Monitor supply chain risks, qualify second sources, and implement mitigation plans for critical network components

• Drive cost reduction through should-cost modeling, value engineering, and long-term agreements while maintaining quality and reliability standards

• Create and implement supplier management programs to develop, continuously improve, and monitor KPIs of the supply base

• Optimize procurement processes from PO to pay so the team spends its time on the highest-value work; reduce transactions through long-term agreements, blanket orders, and automation

• Track team and category KPIs; provide regular updates and recommendations to senior leadership, including contract awards, cost reviews, and critical supply issues

• Foster strong cross-functional collaboration and promote effective supply chain practices across the organization

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree and 8+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; or 12+ years of experience working in one or more of the following in lieu of a degree: Business Supply Chain Engineering

• 6+ years of experience in global supply chain, procurement, or commodity management with a focus on datacenter networking, optical, or semiconductor hardware

• 3+ years of experience building, leading, and managing sourcing teams

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Technical understanding of datacenter network architectures (Ethernet and InfiniBand, scale-up and scale-out fabrics), switches, NICs/DPUs, optics, AEC/DAC, and fiber connectivity

• Background working with network OEMs, optical module and component suppliers, and cable and fiber manufacturers

• Experience managing tier-2 supply chains through capacity reservations, directed-buy, or tri-party agreements

• Previous experience at hyperscalers, network OEMs, optical or semiconductor companies, or AI infrastructure companies with aggressive scaling demands

• Strong leadership, negotiation, analytical, project management, financial modeling, and cross-functional skills

• Effective written, verbal, and presentation communication skills

• Proven ability to secure supply and manage costs in constrained, high-demand markets

• Remarkable problem-solving skills with a bias for speed

• Ability to conduct all activities with the highest degree of integrity

• Passion for SpaceX's mission and excitement about enabling the fastest AI infrastructure builds on Earth

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be able to travel - up to 50% work week travel may be required, including international travel to supplier factories, audits, and critical projects

• Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to meet major cluster-deployment milestones

• Ability to thrive in a dynamic environment with rapidly evolving priorities and world-class execution speed

• This position is based in Austin, TX and requires being onsite - remote work not considered

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. jobs.title: Provider Recruiting Associate - Therapy
jobs.description:
About Us

Health is the most important thing in life, and the American healthcare system is completely broken - poor outcomes, high cost, bad patient experience. We're building a new system from the ground up.

Our mission is to improve people’s health by making it easy to live a healthy lifestyle.

Nourish is the country's largest dietitian-led metabolic health clinic. We’re an AI-native digital health system matching patients with 10,000+ Registered Dietitians, physicians, medications, lab testing, and AI agents to deliver insurance-covered care across all 50 states. Founded four years ago, we've completed millions of appointments, tripled year-over-year, and partnered with health plans covering 200M+ Americans across 250+ health systems.

In 2026 we raised a $100M Series C, bringing total funding to $215M. The round was led by Menlo Ventures, with participation from Thrive Capital, Index Ventures, J.P. Morgan Growth Equity Partners, Maverick Ventures, Y Combinator, BoxGroup, Atomico, Daybreak, and Operator Partners.

Learn more about our Series C here: Nourish Blog, Bloomberg, Fierce Healthcare, Digital Native, The Pulse Podcast.

This is not a job for everyone. We hold an extremely high bar because we believe talent density is our biggest competitive advantage. We're looking for people who actively choose hard, ambiguous problems, who run toward unglamorous work, give and receive candid feedback, and bring relentless resilience without the ego. Our work is important, but we are not self-important. We do this because we’re solving one of the hardest problems in the world, and the problem matters. If that's you, we disproportionately reward it.

About the Role

As a Therapy Provider Recruiting Associate, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the journey for Behavioral Health Therapists looking to join Nourish. The Provider Recruiting Associate is the gateway into Nourish, and is more often than not the first person a Nourish Therapy provider will interact with from Nourish in their journey. This role is centered around creating an amazing hiring experience - vetting candidates, setting up offers, developing timely and encouraging candidate communication plans, and answering complex questions needed to help providers decide if Nourish is the right place for them.

You’ll take full ownership of our Nourish Therapy applicants (a large and growing group each month) and shape their hiring experience from end to end. You’ll help refine and evolve our hiring strategy, taking initiative to improve processes as we grow. And you’ll get to interact every day with providers making meaningful decisions for their careers, and extend them the opportunity to join Nourish’s mission and community.

This person will report into our Care Expansion Lead - you’ll be joining a collaborative and passionate team that’s dedicated to improving lives through better metabolic care, and you’ll be a pivotal player in our vision to help one hundred million people live healthier, longer lives using Nourish.

Key Responsibilities:

• Serve as the dedicated point of contact for candidates, building a deep knowledge of Nourish’s value prop, policies, and processes to effectively communicate with providers

• Own the full candidate lifecycle, from application review and screening through interviews, offer calls, and close

• Deliver an exceptional candidate experience while helping assess clinical fit, alignment with Nourish’s care model, and readiness to thrive in a startup environment.

• Sync regularly with internal stakeholders on candidate feedback, hiring decisions, and pipeline priorities

• Collaborate with Corporate Strategy, Provider Onboarding, Provider Strategy, and Product teams to create feedback loops that improve candidate experience

• Make process improvements based on feedback from providers and internal stakeholders to improve the overall recruiting experience, both qualitatively and quantitatively

• Drive applicant engagement through proactive outreach and timely follow-ups that increase offer acceptance

• Lead outbound recruiting efforts to our highest priority prospects, via personalized emails and calls

We’d love to hear from you if:

• You have 2+ years of experience in recruiting; clinical recruiting or experience recruiting licensed healthcare providers is a plus.

• You are hyper-organized and skilled at managing a high-volume process, handling multiple interactions at once while ensuring no detail is overlooked.

• You have excellent verbal and written communication skills and gain energy from engaging with providers across phone, video, email, and chat.

• You can learn new processes and assume ownership quickly, understanding a detailed process right after having it explained.

• You’re a strong problem-solver who can think on your feet and offer creative solutions to optimize processes.

• You’re passionate about metabolic health, and you’re motivated to help others improve their health by expanding access to high-quality care.

• You’ve excelled in fast-paced start-ups, particularly in healthcare operations, telehealth, SaaS, or tech, where quick thinking and adaptability are key.

About the role

We're hiring a Technical Recruiter to own full-cycle hiring for our engineering, research, and technical go-to-market teams. You'll partner closely with hiring managers and leadership to find, attract, and close the people who build Labelbox, including the forward deployed engineers who work hands-on with our customers.

This is a high-impact seat for someone who loves the craft of recruiting, moves quickly, and wants to shape how a fast-growing AI company hires.

What you'll do

• Own full-cycle recruiting for technical roles: software engineers, ML engineers, research scientists, forward deployed engineers, solutions engineers, and technical leaders.

• Bring market insight to the table: talent availability, comp trends, and what competitors are doing.

What you bring

• 5+ years of technical recruiting experience, ideally split between high-growth startups and agency or in-house settings.

• A track record of closing senior and hard-to-fill engineering roles.

• Comfort with ATS and sourcing tools (Greenhouse, LinkedIn Recruiter, Gem or similar).

• Clear, direct communication and the judgment to push back on hiring managers when needed.

• A bias for speed and ownership in a fast-moving, sometimes ambiguous environment.

Bonus points

• Recruiting experience in AI, ML, or the human data space, such as at a frontier lab, AI infrastructure company, or data labeling / RLHF provider.

• Experience hiring forward deployed engineers or similar hybrid roles (solutions engineers, deployment strategists, customer-facing engineers), and knowing how to assess both technical depth and customer instincts.

• An existing network among ML engineers, researchers, or FDEs.

Annual base salary range

$160,000—$180,000 USD

Life at Labelbox

• Environment: Fast-paced and high-intensity, perfect for ambitious individuals who thrive on ownership and quick decision-making

Our Vision

We believe data will remain crucial in achieving artificial general intelligence. As AI models become more sophisticated, the need for high-quality, specialized training data will only grow. Join us in developing new products and services that enable the next generation of AI breakthroughs.

jobs.title: Professional Civil Engineer
jobs.description:
SUMMARY OF POSITION

The Professional Civil Engineer is responsible for planning, designing, managing, and overseeing civil engineering projects that support plant operations, infrastructure improvements, and facility expansion. This position ensures projects comply with California engineering regulations, applicable building codes, safety standards, budgets, and timelines. The Civil Engineer collaborates with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, and external contractors to develop cost-effective solutions, improve infrastructure reliability, and support continuous improvement initiatives.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Plan, design, and oversee civil engineering projects, including site development, grading, drainage, foundations, utilities, roadways, and facility infrastructure improvements.
• Prepare, review, and approve engineering drawings, technical specifications, calculations, and construction documents in accordance with applicable California regulations and engineering standards, including review of vendor and contractor structural submittals and equipment anchorage designs.
• Design, review, sign, and seal civil and structural engineering drawings and calculations within the scope of professional licensure, competency, and responsible charge including structural steel equipment platforms, mezzanines, catwalks, stairs, ladders, pipe and conveyors supports, and equipment anchorage subject to vibrating and dynamic equipment loads.
• Evaluate the structural integrity of foundations, equipment support, buildings, and existing plant structures, including their capacity for added equipment loads, and provide engineering recommendations.
• Manage engineering projects from initial planning through completion, ensuring compliance with established budgets, timelines, quality standards, and safety requirements.
• Conduct site inspections and engineering assessments to evaluate existing infrastructure, identify deficiencies, and recommend corrective actions or improvements.
• Coordinate with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, contractors, consultants, and regulatory agencies to ensure successful project execution.
• Ensure compliance with applicable California Building Standards Code requirements, environmental regulations, permitting requirements, and company safety policies.
• Develop project budgets, cost estimates, feasibility studies, and recommendations for infrastructure improvements, equipment installations, and capital investments.
• Oversee contractors and construction activities to verify work meets approved engineering plans, specifications, and project requirements.
• Identify opportunities to improve facility infrastructure, operational efficiency, reliability, and long-term maintenance through engineering solutions.
• Lead problem-solving and continuous improvement initiatives using PDCA methodologies to address recurring infrastructure and operational challenges.
• Provide technical guidance and engineering recommendations to management, project teams, and cross-functional departments.
• Maintain accurate engineering documentation, project records, permits, inspection reports, and regulatory compliance records.
• Develop, monitor, maintain, and analyze departmental Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), communicate performance results during Floor Management Development System (FMDS) meetings, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
• Support long-term facility planning, including infrastructure upgrades, expansion projects, and capital improvement initiatives.
• Deliver exceptional customer service by responding to internal and external customer needs, building positive relationships, and ensuring timely and effective resolution of concerns.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

• Bachelor’s degree in civil or Structural Engineering from an ABET-accredited program; MS in structural engineering preferred.
• Minimum of 5 years of civil engineering experience, including at least 3 years designing industrial steel and concrete structures with a record of sealed structural drawings and calculations, preferably involving industrial facilities, manufacturing operations, infrastructure, or construction project management.
• Experience managing capital projects, contractors, engineering consultants, and construction activities.
• Working knowledge of California Building Code (including its structural and seismic provisions), ASCE 7 (including nonbuilding structures and equipment anchorage), AISC steel design standards, ACI 318 concrete design and anchoring, Cal/OSHA and federal OSHA requirements for platforms, guardrails, stairs, and ladders, permitting processes, and applicable environmental regulations.
• Proficiency in AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and in structural analysis and design software such as RISA, STAAD.Pro, SAP2000, or Enercalc.
• Experience preparing engineering calculations, construction drawings, technical specifications, and cost estimates.
• Strong understanding of project management, budgeting, and continuous improvement methodologies.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

• Active California Professional Engineer (P.E.) license in Civil Engineering required; California Structural Engineer (S.E) license preferred.

Pay range: $110,000 - $150,000/yr

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

EEO is the law - click here for more information

jobs.title: Supplier Development Engineer, Electrical (SpaceXSI)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SUPPLIER DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER (SPACEXSI)

SpaceX is seeking a Lead Supplier Development Engineer for the Superintelligence program. You will lead supplier development for one commodity on the supercomputer and data center build: infrastructure (switchgear, busway, power distribution, and rack power), cable and harness, or cooling. You will decide which suppliers are fit to ship, which processes are ready for rate, and how nonconformances get closed.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Build and lead the supplier development engineers for the assigned commodity on SpaceXSI supercomputer and data center hardware

• Set one standard for supplier qualification, first article, production part approval, process control, and corrective action, and hold the team to it

• Work with supply chain, design, reliability, operations, and production so the policy on your commodity is the same from the supplier floor to the site

• Own supplier qualification. Audit the process, the quality system, and the capacity before a supplier is released to ship

• Implement the production part approval process for hardware qualification and approve the pack only when the objective evidence is there

• Read supplier quality and delivery data, find the systemic gap, and put an engineer on the improvement until it is verified

• Run material review, root cause, and 8D with receiving, supplier quality, and the supplier. Contain suspect material in the warehouse and in the hall

• Know how the purchased part goes into the next assembly. Give design for manufacturing feedback while the drawing can still change

• Find the bottleneck, the yield loss, and the rate limiter in the supplier process and remove them

• Set the schedule to bring up a new part or a design change, and track the supplier against that schedule

• Keep receiving inspection, nonconforming material, and traceability tight enough that a rejected part cannot be issued to the build

• Hire, train, and mentor the supplier development engineers on your commodity

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering

• 1+ years of professional experience in electrical engineering, electronics manufacturing, quality engineering, reliability engineering (internship and extracurricular experience is applicable)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience in the assigned commodity: data center power and infrastructure, copper or fiber cable and harness, or data center cooling equipment

• Experience leading engineers or owning a supplier commodity through qualification and rate

• Experience with the production part approval process, first article inspection, and structured root cause

• Master's degree in engineering or business

• Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, or equivalent process-improvement training

• Experience with capacity modeling, process mapping, and yield or fault analysis

• Hands-on experience with electromechanical manufacturing, including harness build, power equipment, or cooling skids

• For cable and harness: working knowledge of IPC/WHMA-A-620 or an equivalent workmanship standard

• For cooling: working knowledge of pumped liquid cooling, heat exchangers, and cleanliness or fluid specifications

• For infrastructure: working knowledge of data center power distribution, from switchgear and busway to rack power

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Position is based in Bastrop, TX and requires being onsite. Remote work is not considered

• Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends when a supplier, a receipt, or a site install is on the critical path

• Ability to travel 50% to supplier facilities

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. jobs.description:
About Bobyard

Construction is a multi-trillion-dollar industry facing a shortage of roughly 349,000 workers — and it still estimates by hand. Contractors spend weeks measuring and counting materials off drawings, and that caps how many jobs they can bid. Bobyard’s AI takes a contractor from a set of plans to a bid in minutes instead of weeks. Our customers run real construction jobs on Bobyard, not demos. We raised a $35M Series A led by 8VC, with Primary and Pear.

Who we are

Builders. We ship real product to real contractors. If it doesn’t survive contact with a live job, it doesn’t count — we don’t do demo-ware.

Owners. There’s no layer between you and the problem, and no permission slip required. When you see the solution, you own it, end to end.

Independent minds. Strong convictions, open minds. We hire for how you think, not where you learned it — show us the work, not the résumé.

Fast movers. We decide quickly and optimize for impact, not consensus. You’ll be judged by the people in the problem with you, on what you deliver.

About the role

You lead product for a major area of Bobyard, with company-level scope: where the product goes over the next 2–3 years, the hard tradeoffs along the way, and the bar for how product is built here. This is a senior IC role for someone who has owned a product end to end and wants to do it again at a company still early in its story.

What you’ll do

• Set the multi-year direction for your area and turn it into a roadmap

• Become one of the deepest customer experts in the company

• Lead new efforts from thesis to prototype to repeatable revenue

• Align engineering, design, sales, marketing, and CS on priorities and launches

• Define how we spec, prioritize, and run discovery, and mentor other PMs

What we’re looking for

• 7+ years in product management, owning strategy for a product or product line

• Shipped at least one 0→1 product with real customer traction

• Built AI/ML-driven products or B2B software for complex workflows

• Strong judgment under ambiguity, with reasoning you can explain

• You’ve mentored PMs or helped build a product practice

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or the equivalent combination of education and specialized experience

Nice to have

• Construction industry experience

A note on pace

We move fast, and priorities shift as we learn from customers. Playbooks, context, and requirements are often incomplete when work starts, and you’ll be expected to shape them. If that pace excites you, you’ll fit in well.

What we offer

Cash for stability. Bonus for performance. Equity for ownership. Your package reflects your role, your experience, and what you deliver, and it grows as you do.

• $170,000–$190,000 base + $10,000–$30,000 bonus + 0.02%–0.06% equity

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4%

• Catered lunch in the office and $70 a month toward your commute

• Full-time, in person at our San Francisco office (101 2nd Street), 4 days a week.

Come build with us!

jobs.title: Sourcing Manager (Compute Infrastructure)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SOURCING MANAGER (COMPUTE INFRASTRUCTURE)

We are a progressive procurement organization pushing the boundaries of traditional procurement reputation and methodologies. We are looking for individuals who can think outside the box to achieve company objectives regarding value and partnerships with our suppliers. Our organization moves quickly, and you must too. SpaceX has the unique ability and desire to influence and shape suppliers to be better with us as we challenge our supply chain on cost, quality, and delivery.

In this role you will own end-to-end sourcing for AI compute hardware across one or more categories: GPU/accelerator systems, OEM/ODM rack systems, CPU racks and servers, and compute spares, warranty, and support. You will partner with engineering and platform teams on roadmaps and configurations, secure allocation and capacity, and deliver racks to site on SpaceXAI's aggressive cluster build schedules at the best total cost. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in compute hardware sourcing, thrives in high-ambiguity, high-velocity environments, and has a proven track record of securing supply in constrained, high-demand markets.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Own end-to-end sourcing for assigned AI compute categories, which may include GPU/accelerator systems, OEM/ODM rack systems, CPU racks and x86 servers, and compute spares and service

• Partner with engineering, architecture, and platform teams on roadmaps, configurations, and approved vendor lists, anticipating platform transitions 12–24 months ahead

• Run RFQs and competitive bids across OEMs, ODMs, and CMs; benchmark configured system pricing against component should-cost (GPU, CPU, memory, storage, networking, chassis, and integration)

• Manage allocation, clear-to-build, orders, and deliveries against cluster build schedules; expedite and recover late shipments

• Support direct-buy and consignment programs that supply ODMs and CMs with key components

• Negotiate warranty, support, and service agreements, including SLAs for response time, repair turnaround, and advance replacement, and run the RMA loop with suppliers and site teams

• Monitor supply chain risks and implement mitigation plans for critical compute components

• Create, negotiate, and administer supply agreements, SOWs, and purchase orders in collaboration with the legal department; manage contracts to ensure supplier performance to contract obligations

• Conduct market research, benchmarking, and advanced quantitative analyses to identify the financial impact of decisions and set targets for cost savings, payment terms, and cash

• Collaborate with stakeholders to define SLAs and KPIs for suppliers (cost, quality, delivery, and resilience); run performance scorecards and business reviews, and drive corrective action

• Identify and execute cost reduction projects, including planning, coordinating with stakeholders, estimating completion, and reporting progress

• Present value propositions to SpaceX management, including contract awards, cost reviews, cost reduction strategies, and critical supply issues

• Place purchase orders, resolve blocked invoices, and streamline the PO-to-pay process to reduce transactions and cycle time for assigned categories

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Advanced degree and 3+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; or bachelor’s degree and 5+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; or 9+ years of experience working in one or more of the following: Engineering Purchasing Contract negotiation Material or production planning Operations or supply chain management Material cost control Master production scheduling

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• 4+ years of experience in global supply chain, commodity management, or sourcing with a focus on compute hardware (GPU/accelerator systems, servers, and/or OEM/ODM rack systems)

• Technical understanding of rack-scale GPU systems, accelerators, CPUs, server and rack architectures, and OEM/ODM/CM build models

• Previous experience at hyperscalers, server OEMs or ODMs, GPU/accelerator suppliers, or AI infrastructure companies

• Experience with rack integration (L10/L11), consignment, clear-to-build, or warranty and RMA processes

• Strong negotiation, analytical, project management, and cross-functional collaboration skills

• Strong contract management, budget tracking, cost analysis, and financial modeling skills

• Effective written, verbal, and presentation communication skills

• Remarkable problem-solving skills with a bias for speed

• Strong technical knowledge of current tools and applications (e.g., MS Office Suite, SQL, Power BI)

• Ability to conduct all activities with the highest degree of integrity

• Detail-oriented, self-motivated, and able to respond quickly to a fast-moving and ever-changing environment

• Passion for SpaceX's mission and excitement about enabling the fastest AI infrastructure builds on Earth

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be able to travel - up to 50% work week travel may be required, including international travel to supplier factories, audits, and critical projects

• Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to meet major cluster-deployment milestones

• Ability to thrive in a dynamic environment with rapidly evolving priorities and world-class execution speed

• This position is based in Bastrop, TX and requires being onsite - remote work not considered

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.
